title: Head of Operations / Plant Manager
description:
**Company Description**  

Wabtec Corporation https://www.wabteccorp.com is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value\-added services for freight and transit rail as well as the mining, marine, and industrial markets. Drawing on nearly four centuries of collective experience across Wabtec, GE Transportation, and Faiveley Transport, the company has grown to become One Wabtec, with unmatched digital expertise, technological innovation, and world\-class manufacturing and services, enabling the digital\-rail\-and\-transit ecosystems.  

  

Wabtec is focused on performance that drives progress and unlocks our customers’ potential by delivering innovative and lasting transportation solutions that move and improve the world. We are lifelong learners obsessed with making things better to drive exceptional results. Wabtec has approximately 30K employees in facilities throughout the world.


This role is in one of our recently acquired company \- **Frauscher Sensor Technology India Private Limited,** A Wabtec company) www.frauscher.in .

 **Job Description** **Position Title \- Head of Operations / Plant Manager**

**Location \- Mysore, Karnataka.**

**Role Summary – As the Plant Manager for our upcoming plant in Mysore,** you will work closely with a cross\-functional manufacturing leadership team including Supply Chain, Quality, Engineering, Finance, HR, and Project teams. The role involves strong collaboration with local and global sites to align production, supply chain, and quality objectives with overall business strategy. You will be responsible for leading end\-to\-end production operations at the Mysore site, including production planning, quality, logistics, procurement, and supply chain. You will support business objectives by ensuring safe, compliant, cost\-effective, and high\-quality manufacturing operations while driving continuous improvement initiatives. This role leads process optimization, capital investment planning, and people development.


The role reports to Global Operations Leader and works closely with the Managing Director.

**Key Job Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage production, planning, quality, logistics, and procurement activities at the Mysore facility in close collaboration and co\-ordination with our global site/s
* Ensure highest level of EHS Standards at the pant
* Design/implement processes/procedures that effectively support the business.
* Generate, cultivate and communicate ideas for continual improvement of processes and activities across all areas of the operation.
* Drive achievement of production targets related to cost, quality, delivery, and safety
* Monitor and continuously improve production processes using Lean and continuous improvement tools
* Manage departmental budgeting, forecasting, and capital investment planning
* Coach, mentor, and develop direct and indirect team members; identify skill gaps and training needs
* All Financial, Commercial \& Administrative Approvals
* Ensure all Process, System \& Access Governance at met


Ensure every Quality, Safety \& Compliance standards are met at the plant

 **Qualifications** **Required Experience \& Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in production engineering, Operations, Business Management, or a comparable discipline
* Minimum 15\+ years of experience in production or manufacturing operations with proven leadership, strong technical knowledge of electronics assembly or electronic manufacturing services (EMS).
* Experience with high\-level strategic planning and daily tactical management of production lines, primarily focusing on high\-precision electronics like Printed Circuit Board Assemblies (PCBAs).
* Proven leadership experience managing medium\-sized manufacturing operations with serial production with a global footprint.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, supply chain management, and production planning \& control
* Experience with Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, and process optimization methodologies
* High level of quality awareness and operational excellence mindset
* Experience working in an MNC; international exposure preferred

  

**Additional Information** **Our Commitment to Embrace Diversity \-** Wabtec is a global company that invests not just in our products, but also our people by embracing diversity and inclusion. We care about our relationships with our employees and take pride in celebrating the variety of experiences, expertise, and backgrounds that bring us together. At Wabtec, we aspire to create a place where we all belong and where diversity is welcomed and appreciated. To fulfill that commitment, we rely on a culture of leadership, diversity, and inclusion. We aim to employ the world’s brightest minds to help us create a limitless source of ideas and opportunities. We have created a space where everyone is given the opportunity to contribute based on their individual experiences and perspectives and recognize that these differences and diverse perspectives make us better.We believe in hiring talented people of varied backgrounds, experiences, and styles… People like you!  

Wabtec Corporation is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or protected Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

**What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?**


At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job \- it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it \- for our clients and each other.


If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you.  



**Who are we?**


Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value\-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike.


Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We’re lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at www.WabtecCorp.com.

**Culture powers us and the possibilities.**


We believe the best ideas come from a mix of experiences and backgrounds. At Wabtec, we strive every day to create a place where everyone belongs. We’re building a culture where leadership, inclusion and your unique perspective fuel progress.

  

We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome talent of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including race, gender, age, disability, veteran status and more.


Need accommodation? Just let us know \- we’ve got you.

Job Title:\- Recruiter

  


**Position summary**  

  

The Recruiter will be responsible for managing the full\-cycle recruitment process to attract, assess, and hire top talent across various functions within the organization. This role involves partnering closely with hiring managers, HRBP to understand staffing needs, sourcing candidates through multiple channels, conducting initial screenings, coordinating interviews, and ensuring a positive candidate experience. The role plays a key role in building a strong talent pipeline and supporting the company’s growth by bringing in the right people at the right time.

  



**Responsibilities**


* Collaborate with hiring managers to understand current and future hiring needs across departments
* Develop and execute effective sourcing strategies to attract top talent through job portals,social media, employee referrals, networking, and other channels
* Manage the end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle — from job posting and screening to offer negotiation till onboarding
* Maintain job descriptions and ensure all postings are consistent and aligned with company branding
* Conduct initial resume screening and interviews to assess candidates' skills, experience, and cultural fit
* Schedule and coordinate interviews between candidates and hiring managers, ensuring timely feedback collection

* Develop and maintain a Hiring dashboard and analytics framework to track key recruitment metrics and support data\-driven decision\-making.
* Coordinate onboarding processes and schedule induction sessions to ensure smooth new\-hire transitions and effective cross\-functional orientation.
* Ensure compliance with legal and organizational hiring practices throughout the recruitment process
* Monitor and report key recruitment metrics (e.g., time\-to\-fill, cost\-per\-hire, diversity hiring, source effectiveness) to improve hiring efficiency
* Assist in refining recruitment processes, tools, and best practices for improved efficiency and candidate experience (HR Roadmap Project)

* Promote and enhance CIRCOR’s employer brand by delivering a positive, professional, and consistent candidate experience.
* Track and maintain structured recruitment dashboards and reports.
* Coordinate the Onboarding process to ensure smooth new\-hire transitions.
* Schedule induction sessions to provide cross\-functional orientation as proposed by the Hiring Manager.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to provide necessary resources, tools, and support for new employees to be productive from day one.
* Monitor and track new hire integration during the initial months.
* Act as the first point of contact for new joiners, addressing queries and ensuring an engaging experience.
* Gather feedback to refine and continuously improve the onboarding process.
  


**Candidate Requirements**


* Bachelors / master’s degree in human resources.
* Bachelors with minimum 3\+ years of experience in human resources.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) and comfort working with databases and HR tools
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Proven ability to handle competing priorities effectively in a fast\-paced setting

description:
**About Mampilly Group**

Mampilly Group is a diversified business group engaged in **plywood manufacturing and allied industries**, with multiple production units and a growing trading division under the **Plymarc brand**. The group operates manufacturing facilities and trading operations with a strong focus on quality, operational excellence, and sustainable growth.

We are currently strengthening our organizational structure and are looking for an **experienced HR Manager** to develop and lead the Human Resources function across the group.

**Position Summary**

The HR Manager will be responsible for **developing and leading the HR Department**, ensuring **full compliance with labour laws**, strengthening **HR systems and policies**, and building a **structured workforce management system** across units.

This role requires a **hands\-on HR professional with strong knowledge of labour law compliance in manufacturing industries**.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. HR Department Development**

* Develop the **HR Department structure and processes** for the group.
* Develop HR policies, procedures, and employee handbook.
* Define HR systems covering recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and employee relations.
* Implement HR documentation and record management systems.

**2\. Labour Law \& Statutory Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with all applicable labour laws.
* Address compliance issues identified by labour department inspections.
* Maintain statutory registers and documentation.
* Coordinate with labour authorities and statutory consultants.

**3\. Workforce Management**

* Develop manpower planning for manufacturing units and trading division.
* Create structured **organizational hierarchy and job roles**.
* Implement attendance, leave, and shift management systems.
* Monitor contract labour and statutory compliance related to labour deployment.

**4\. Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition**

* Lead recruitment for all levels including production staff, supervisors, executives, and management.
* Manage recruitment through job portals such as **LinkedIn**, **Indeed** and other platforms.
* Develop structured interview and selection processes.
* Support department heads in building strong teams.

**5\. Employee Policies \& HR Systems**

* Develop and implement policies related to:
* Attendance and leave
* Performance appraisal
* Employee discipline
* Grievance handling
* Code of conduct
* Establish employee documentation and personnel files.

**6\. Performance Management**

* Implement a **performance appraisal system** across the organization.
* Align employee performance with organizational goals.
* Coordinate training and development initiatives.

**7\. Employee Engagement \& Workplace Culture**

* Develop employee engagement initiatives.
* Address employee grievances and workplace concerns.
* Conduct employee awareness sessions on policies and compliance.

**8\. HR Reporting \& Management Support**

* Provide HR insights and reports to top management.
* Support management in organizational restructuring and workforce optimization.
* Develop HR dashboards and MIS reports.

**Qualifications**

* MBA / PGDM in Human Resource Management or equivalent.
* Additional certification in labour laws or industrial relations preferred.

**Experience**

* Minimum **5–10 years of HR experience**, preferably in **manufacturing industries**.
* Strong knowledge of **Indian labour laws and statutory compliance**.
* Experience in **setting up HR systems and processes from scratch** will be highly preferred.

**Skills Required**

* Labour law expertise
* HR policy development
* Industrial relations
* Recruitment and workforce planning
* Strong documentation and compliance management
* Excellent communication and leadership skills

**Why Join Mampilly Group**

* Opportunity to **develop and lead the HR function from the ground up**
* Work closely with **top management in organizational transformation**
* Exposure to **manufacturing and trading business environments**

title: HR Executive
description:
**ABOUT THE BLOX GROUP**

The Blox Preschool Group is a fast\-growing education and energy organisation based in Panipat, Haryana operating under Learnify Education. We run two branches of The Blox Preschool (Model Town and Huda 13/17\) with a combined team of 50\+ staff, along with a B2B bulk diesel fuel station.

We are a systems\-driven organisation with documented SOPs, FMS processes, checklists, and KRA\-based performance measurement already in place. We are now looking for a dedicated HR Executive to manage our most important asset — our people.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

You will be the HR Executive for The Blox Group — owning the complete HR function across both preschool branches and the fuel station. This is a standalone HR role responsible for keeping our team strong, trained, and performing.

With 50\+ team members and constant movement at the teaching level, this role requires someone who is organised, proactive, and comfortable managing the full employee lifecycle from recruitment to exit.

**YOUR 6 CORE RESPONSIBILITIES**

Based on our HR Management Framework:

**1\. RECRUITMENT**

* Post job openings on Indeed, Apna, Workindia, LinkedIn, and internal references
* Screen CVs and conduct first\-round phone interviews
* Coordinate second and third round interviews with branch heads and owner
* Maintain a live Recruitment Tracker — all candidates, stages, and outcomes logged
* Maintain a substitute teacher panel — minimum 5 to 8 ready\-to\-deploy teachers at all times
* Owner takes only the final interview — everything before that is your responsibility
* Target: fill any open position within 10 to 14 days of it opening

**2\. INDUCTION PROCESS**

* Issue Offer Letter with 3\-month probation terms on day of selection
* Ensure new joinee submits resignation from previous organisation within 7 days
* Issue Joining Letter on Day 1 of joining
* Conduct full Day 1 induction — meeting with owner, org chart walkthrough, reporting structure, company values, FMS and checklist handover
* Collect and digitise all documents — educational, residential, personal
* Issue Appointment and Confirmation Letter after 3 to 6 months of probation
* Maintain individual staff files — physical and digital — for all 50\+ team members

**3\. TRAINING PROCESS**

* Identify training needs for each role quarterly — knowledge, skill set, team building, leadership
* Coordinate and schedule monthly training sessions for teaching and non\-teaching staff
* Maintain training attendance records
* Ensure all new joiners complete their role\-specific FMS and checklist training within first 2 weeks
* Coordinate with branch heads for on\-the\-job training support

**4\. DAILY LEAVE MANAGEMENT**

* Manage daily attendance and leave across both branches
* When a teacher calls in leave — immediately activate substitute from the substitute panel
* Inform branch head and coordinate coverage within 30 minutes of leave notification
* Maintain monthly leave records for all staff
* Flag excessive leave patterns to owner in weekly report
* Ensure no class is ever uncovered due to teacher absence

**5\. APPRAISALS AND INCREMENTS**

* Conduct quarterly appraisals for all staff based on MIS score (80%) and Delegation Sheet (20%)
* Prepare individual appraisal hard copy for each staff member every quarter
* Calculate increment eligibility — yearly, maximum 7\-10% , automatic based on scores
* Present increment recommendations to owner — no negotiation, purely number\-based
* Maintain appraisal history for every employee from date of joining

**6\. EXIT PROCESS**

* Conduct exit interview for every departing employee — find actual reason for exit
* Identify organisational gaps from exit feedback and report to owner
* Manage 15\-day notice period and handover process
* Ensure all company property returned and documentation completed
* Maintain an exit log — patterns identified and shared with owner quarterly
* Always leave the departing employee on a good note — never burn bridges

**YOUR DAILY ROUTINE**

8:30 AM — Check attendance for both branches. Any absent teacher — activate substitute immediately. 9:00 AM — Confirm substitute coverage confirmed and branch head informed. 10:00 AM — Check open recruitment positions — follow up on pending candidates. 11:00 AM — Handle any HR documentation, file updates, or correspondence. 12:00 PM — Coordinate with branch heads on any staff issues or concerns. 3:00 PM — Update Recruitment Tracker and Staff Database. 5:00 PM — Prepare daily HR update — leave status, open positions, any escalations.

Every Monday — Submit HR weekly report to owner: attendance summary, open positions, appraisal dates due, any staff concerns.

Every Friday — Update appraisal scores and prepare for quarterly review if due.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

Must\-Have Qualities:

* ORGANISED — you maintain files, trackers, and records without anything slipping
* PEOPLE\-ORIENTED — you can have difficult conversations with staff kindly and firmly
* PROACTIVE — you fill positions before they become a crisis, not after
* SYSTEMATIC — you follow the HR framework without needing reminders
* CONFIDENTIAL — all staff information handled with complete discretion
* CALM UNDER PRESSURE — when 3 teachers call in sick on the same day, you handle it

Skills Required:

* Strong communication in Hindi and English
* Proficient with Google Sheets, WhatsApp, Gmail, basic documentation
* Comfortable conducting interviews and giving feedback to candidates
* Experience managing staff attendance and leave systems
* Basic knowledge of offer letters, joining letters, and HR documentation

Qualifications:

* Graduate in any discipline — MBA in HR or BBA preferred
* Minimum 1 to 2 years experience in HR, administration, or people management
* Experience in a school, preschool, or education organisation is a strong plus
* Panipat\-based or willing to relocate — immediate joining required

**DO NOT APPLY IF:**

* You are comfortable sitting at your desk and waiting for HR issues to come to you
* You cannot handle the pressure of urgent daily requirements like teacher substitution
* You have never managed more than 10 people's attendance and documentation
* You need to be told every day what your HR priorities are

**DO APPLY IF:**

* You have managed recruitment, induction, and staff documentation independently
* You are the person who always has a backup plan ready before it is needed
* You understand that in an education organisation, no child should ever sit in an uncovered class
* You want to build and own the HR department of a growing organisation

**WHAT YOU GET**

Salary: Rs. 15,000 – 25,000 per month based on experience and capability Salary review after 3 months and 6 months based on performance Role Type: Full Time \| On\-Site \| Panipat, Haryana — covers both preschool branches Working Days: Monday to Saturday Joining: Immediate — within 2 weeks of selection Growth: As the organisation expands to more branches, this role grows with it Training: Complete HR framework, SOPs, and system training provided from Day 1

**HOW TO APPLY**

Send your CV with the subject line: "HR Application — \[Your Name] — \[Your Experience in Years]"

Answer these 3 questions in 2 to 3 lines each:

* Tell us about a time you had to fill an urgent staff vacancy quickly. What did you do?
* How do you currently manage daily attendance and leave for a large team?
* If 3 teachers call in absent on the same morning, what is your step by step response?

Candidates who do not answer these 3 questions will not be reviewed.

**SELECTION PROCESS**

Step 1 — CV and 3\-question screening Step 2 — 20\-minute phone interview Step 3 — In\-person interview at Panipat office Step 4 — 2\-day paid trial Step 5 — Final offer within 48 hours of trial

Total hiring time: 7 to 10 days

We are building an organisation where every team member is recruited right, inducted properly, trained continuously, and rewarded based purely on performance numbers.

If you want to build and own that system — apply immediately.

The Blox Preschool Group, Panipat

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

 We’re seeking a results\-driven Global Training \& Development Specialist to lead the design and delivery of high impact learning programs across our global organization. title: Director, Human Resources - IMEA
description:
**Role Summary**



The Director, Human Resources – IMEA is a senior enterprise HR leadership role responsible for translating global people's strategy into regional impact while representing IMEA priorities within a highly matrixed global HR operating model.



Reporting to the CHRO, this role acts as a strategic advisor to regional and functional C‑suite leaders, partnering across a network of Global HR Centers of Excellence (Talent, Leadership \& Culture, Total Rewards, Talent Acquisition, HR Services, and People Analytics). The role balances regional business ownership with enterprise standardization, ensuring global HR frameworks are effectively localized in complex, multi‑country environments.



The Director, HR – IMEA is accountable for shaping talent, leadership, rewards, succession, and organizational capability, while influencing outcomes through collaboration and governance rather than direct control. As a member of the HR Leadership Team, the role contributes region‑specific insights to enterprise decisions and drives adoption of global priorities across IMEA. The role also provides regional leadership oversight for Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR).

  


**Key Responsibilities**


**Strategic Business \& Executive Partnership**


* Serve as the primary HR advisor to the IMEA Regional Leaders, executive team, and functional leaders.
* Shape business and operating strategy through insight‑driven people and leadership recommendations.
* Influence outcomes in a matrixed environment through credibility, governance, and collaboration.

  


**Matrixed Operating Model \& Global COE Partnership**


* Act as the regional integrator of global HR COE strategies, ensuring enterprise frameworks are executed effectively within IMEA’s regulatory and cultural context.
* Partner closely with Global COEs to co‑own:
	+ Talent and succession strategy
	+ Leadership development and executive capability
	+ Total rewards and executive compensation governance
	+ Workforce analytics and insights
* Provide proactive regional input into global program design, policy development, and prioritization.
* Resolve tensions between global standardization and local flexibility through structured governance and escalation.

  


**Talent Management, Succession \& Executive Recruitment**


* Own the regional talent and succession management agenda, aligned to enterprise expectations and future leadership needs.
* Lead senior executive recruitment across IMEA in partnership with Global TA COEs and executive search firms.
* Facilitate executive talent reviews, succession forums, and readiness discussions.
* Coach senior leaders on executive selection, performance differentiation, succession risk, and leadership transitions.

  


**Leadership Capability \& Culture**


* Deploy global leadership models and capability frameworks in partnership with COEs, ensuring relevance and adoption within IMEA.
* Build leadership depth and bench strength through targeted development, coaching, and experiential learning.
* Shape an inclusive, high‑performance leadership culture aligned with enterprise values and growth objectives.
* Sponsor regional leadership and culture initiatives while ensuring enterprise consistency.

  


**Total Rewards \& Executive Compensation Strategy**


* Act as the regional steward and influencer of total rewards strategy within global governance frameworks.
* Partner with Global Total Rewards COE on:
	+ Executive compensation design and decisions
	+ Market competitiveness and pay equity analysis
	+ Annual compensation and incentive planning cycles
* Advise senior leaders on reward trade‑offs, governance requirements, and market positioning.

  


**Organization Design, Workforce Planning \& Transformation**


* Lead regional workforce and capability planning in partnership with business leaders and global COEs.
* Drive organization design, restructuring, and transformation initiatives across a matrixed enterprise.
* Lead change management, leadership alignment, and communication for global and regional initiatives.

  


**Employee \& Labor Relations Leadership**


* In alignment with the Global LR COE, set a proactive, regionally consistent employee and labor relations strategy.
* Manage complex employee relations matters and high‑risk escalations.
* Partner with Global and Regional Labor Relations experts to engage unions
* Lead and sign complex, long‑term wage settlements; demonstrated hands‑on experience is essential.


**Governance, Risk, Compliance \& CSR**
* Ensure compliance with employment law, labor regulations, data privacy, and HR governance standards across IMEA.
* Identify and mitigate people‑related risk in collaboration with Legal, Compliance, and Global HR partners.
* Provide executive oversight for CSR strategy, compliance, and statutory obligations across the region.

  


**Workforce Analytics \& Insight**


* Leverage global people's analytics frameworks to generate regional insight.
* Partner with COEs to translate data into action on engagement, retention, leadership effectiveness, productivity, and risk.

  


**HR Team Leadership \& Enterprise Contribution**


* Lead and develop a high‑impact regional HR leadership team within a matrixed structure.
* Build succession pipelines for critical HR roles.
* Contribute actively to the HR Leadership Team, shaping enterprise HR priorities and transformations.
* Champion alignment, integration, and disciplined execution across regions and functions.

  


**Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business Administration, or related field  

 (Advanced degree and/or professional certification preferred)
* 22\+ years of progressive HR leadership experience in multinational, matrixed organizations.
* Proven experience partnering with:
	+ Global HR COEs
	+ Regional and functional C‑suite leaders
* Demonstrated depth in:
	+ Executive recruitment
	+ Leadership and succession planning
	+ Total rewards and executive compensation
	+ Labor relations in complex environments
* Strong multi‑country employment law knowledge.
* Fluent in English; additional regional languages preferred.

  


**Leadership Capabilities \& Core Competencies**


* Enterprise mindset with the ability to operate effectively in a matrixed global organization
* Influence without authority; strong governance and stakeholder management skills
* Executive presence with comfort engaging C‑suite and executive stakeholders
* Strategic depth across talent, leadership, and rewards
* Strong labor relations and negotiation capability, including wage settlements
* Data‑driven decision maker with systems thinking
* Values‑based, inclusive leadership with strong ethical standards

  


**Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in human resources, Business Administration, or related field (advanced degree or relevant certification preferred).
* Minimum 15 years of progressive HR experience within multinational/international organizations, including significant leadership experience in a regional or multi\-country role.
* Demonstrated experience partnering with senior leaders to establish HR strategy, programs, tools, policies, and processes; recognized as a strategic advisor and effective change agent.
* Strong working knowledge of employment/labor law and compliance considerations across multiple countries; experience navigating complex employee/labor relations matters.
* Proficiency in English required; additional languages relevant to the region are a plus.

**Skills \& Core Competencies**


* Strategic business partnership and consulting mindset; ability to understand business strategy, competitive landscape, and translate into actionable people plans.
* Strong leadership capability develops teams, builds bench strength, and models of collaboration across cultures and geographies.
* Change management, organizational design, and strategic workforce planning expertise.
* Employee and labor relations leadership, including strong judgment, investigation skills, and the ability to manage sensitive matters with discretion. Signing complex long term wage settlement is an important competency, and experience in this domain is a must.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills; executive presence to represent HR in internal and external forums.
* Analytical and data\-driven problem solving; comfortable using metrics to identify trends, diagnose root causes, and measure outcomes.
* Strong project/program management skills; able to operate effectively in fast\-paced, ambiguous environments and manage competing priorities.
* High standards for confidentiality, ethics, and professionalism.

**Key Working Relationships**


* IMEA regional business leadership team and functional leaders
* HR Leadership Team (HRLT), CHRO, and peer Regional HR Directors
* HR Centers of Excellence (Talent \& Culture, Total Rewards, Talent Acquisition, HR Services/Leveraged Services, HRIS/People Analytics as applicable)
* Site/Country HR leaders and HR Business Partners supporting IMEA businesses and functions
* Legal, Compliance, Finance, HSES, and other cross\-functional partners
* External stakeholders as needed (e.g., labor unions/works councils, consultants, government agencies).

Mercari is a Japan\-based C2C marketplace company founded in 2013 with the mission to “Create value in a global marketplace where anyone can buy \& sell.” From being the first tech unicorn from Japan before its IPO in 2018 we have come a long way towards becoming a global player and continuously and diligently work towards our transformation journey with a strong focus on our mission.


Since its inception, Mercari Group has worked to grow its services, investing in both our people and technology. Over time, Mercari has expanded from being the top player in the C2C marketplace in Japan to new geographies like the U.S. We have also successfully launched new businesses such as Merpay, which is a mobile payment service platform with a vision to create a society where anyone can realise their dreams through a new ecosystem centered not only on payment service but also on credit. Today, Mercari Group is made up of multiple subsidiary businesses, including logistics, B2C platform, blockchain, and sports team management.


About Mercari India
Established in Bangalore in 2022, Mercari India serves as a crucial technology hub for the Mercari Group. Leveraging the rich and diverse tech talent in India, we primarily collaborate closely with our development hub in Japan to drive engineering development for Mercari's applications. Having grown to an organization of approximately 80 members over about three years since its inception, Mercari India aims to evolve into an even stronger engineering organization that spearheads technological innovation for the entire group. This will be achieved by further enhancing our engineering capabilities and promoting AI initiatives that reflect India's cutting\-edge technology and knowledge.  

  

Our Culture


To achieve our mission at Mercari, our organisation and each of our employees share the same values and perspectives.


Our individual guidelines for action are defined by our four values:

* Go Bold
* All for One
* Be a Pro
* Move Fast


Our organisation is also shaped by our four foundations:

* Sustainability
* Diversity \& Inclusion
* Trust \& Openness
* Well\-being for Performance


Regardless of how big Mercari gets, the culture will remain essential to achieving our mission and something we want to preserve throughout our organisation.


We invite you to read the which summarizes the behaviours and mindset shared by Mercari and its employees. We continue to build an environment where all of our members of diverse backgrounds are accepted and recognised, and where they can thrive while holding dear to Mercari’s culture.

**Work Responsibilities**


As a PMO / Program Manager, you will play a critical role in driving program\-level execution tracking across the organization. This position focuses on scaling execution hygiene, improving visibility, and ensuring alignment across multiple teams and initiatives.


You will work closely with cross\-functional stakeholders including engineering, business, HR, corporate, and other teams, ensuring seamless coordination, structured tracking, and timely delivery against organizational priorities and OKRs.


What you will do* Drive program\-level execution tracking across multiple initiatives
* Ensure strong execution hygiene through structured tracking, follow\-ups, and accountability
* Drive quarterly planning cycles, ensuring alignment of priorities, clear goal\-setting (OKRs), and coordinated execution across teams
* Monitor progress against KRs / OKRs, ensuring alignment with organizational priorities
* Identify risks, dependencies, and bottlenecks, and proactively drive resolution
* Run program reviews, status meetings, and governance rituals
* Build and maintain execution dashboards, trackers, and reporting frameworks
* Standardize and continuously improve execution processes and best practices
* Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders including engineering, product, and business teams
* Partner with leadership to provide clear visibility on program health and outcomes
* Drive alignment across teams with differing priorities and working styles
* Provide structured insights, status reports, and escalation summaries
* Enable data\-driven decision\-making through clear and actionable reporting
* Ensure leadership has real\-time visibility into execution progress and risks
* Ensure that tasks and deliverables are on track
* Drive a culture of ownership, follow\-through, and delivery excellence

**Bold Challenges**

* Driving execution at scale: Bring structure and visibility across multiple programs without slowing teams down
* Aligning diverse stakeholders: Work seamlessly across tech and non\-tech teams to ensure delivery
* Creating clarity from complexity: Turn fragmented updates into actionable insights for leadership
* Balancing rigor with agility: Maintain execution discipline in a fast\-moving product environment
* Leveraging AI for impact: Use AI tools to enhance tracking, reporting, and decision\-making

  

**Requirements** **Required Experience**

  

* Empathy for Mercari’s mission and values
* 3\-7 years of experience as a PMO or Program Manager in a technology product company
* Proven experience working with both engineering (tech) and non\-tech teams
* Strong experience in program tracking, execution management, and stakeholder coordination
* Solid understanding of project/program management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid)
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving skills
* Experience using tools such as JIRA, Confluence, Asana, or similar
* Business\-level proficiency in English

 **Preferred Experience**

  

* Experience in scaling program management practices in a growing organization
* Exposure to global or cross\-cultural team environments
* Experience in OKR/KR tracking and execution frameworks
* Familiarity with AI tools to enhance productivity, reporting, and execution tracking
* Certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile (Scrum, etc.)

  

**Benefits**  

Employment Status : Full\-time


Office location: Bangalore

**Hybrid workstyle**


(We believe in high performance and professionalism. We work from office for 2 days/week and work from home 3 days/week


To build a strong \& highly\-engaged organization in India, we highly encourage everyone to work from our Bangalore office, especially during the initial office setup phase


We will continue to review and update the policy to address future organizational needs)

**Work Hours**


Full flextime (no core time)

description:
**Job Description – SR. HR Executive** 

**Company:** CoachX.Live

**About CoachX.Live**

CoachX.Live is a fast\-growing upskilling and career development platform focused on helping students build job\-ready skills and achieve successful placements. We are committed to creating a strong learning ecosystem supported by efficient HR processes and career opportunities.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a proactive and detail\-oriented **HR Executive** who will manage core HR functions, drive recruitment, and support student placement activities. This role requires strong coordination skills, ownership, and the ability to handle multiple responsibilities efficiently.

**Key Responsibilities1\. Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition**

* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment (sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer rollout)
* Post job openings on portals and manage candidate pipelines
* Screen resumes and shortlist candidates as per requirements
* Coordinate interviews with hiring managers
* Ensure timely closure of open positions
* Maintain recruitment trackers and databases

**2\. HR Operations**

* Handle day\-to\-day HR activities and operations
* Manage complete employee lifecycle (onboarding to exit)
* Conduct onboarding and induction sessions
* Maintain employee records and HR systems

**3\. Payroll \& Attendance Management**

* Track daily employee attendance and maintain accuracy
* Prepare payroll inputs (attendance, leaves, deductions)
* Coordinate timely and error\-free salary processing
* Maintain payroll records and ensure compliance

**4\. Employee Engagement \& Support**

* Address employee queries and concerns promptly
* Plan and execute engagement activities
* Support performance tracking and feedback processes
* Maintain a positive and professional work environment

**5\. Student Placement Support**

* Assist in sharing job and internship opportunities with students
* Coordinate student interviews and scheduling
* Maintain placement trackers and update records regularly
* Support collection of student feedback, testimonials, and reviews
* Coordinate with trainers and placement team

**6\. Documentation \& Compliance**

* Prepare HR documents (offer letters, appointment letters, etc.)
* Maintain proper documentation and employee records
* Ensure adherence to HR policies and processes

**7\. Exit Management**

* Manage resignation and exit processes
* Conduct exit interviews and documentation
* Handle clearance formalities

**Key Result Areas (KRA)**

* Efficient recruitment and timely hiring closures
* Smooth HR operations and lifecycle management
* 100% accurate payroll and attendance tracking
* High employee satisfaction and engagement
* Effective placement coordination and tracking

**Key Performance Indicators (KPI)**

* Hiring closure within timelines
* Attendance and payroll accuracy
* Query resolution within 24–48 hours
* Documentation compliance
* Regular engagement activities (1–2 per month)
* Placement tracking and interview coordination

**Required Skills**

* Strong communication and coordination skills
* Good organizational and multitasking ability
* Attention to detail (especially in payroll \& data)
* Basic knowledge of HR processes and recruitment
* Proficiency in MS Excel/Google Sheets

**Working Details**

* **Mode:** Hybrid
* **Location:** Pune
* **Timings:** 10:00 AM – 7PM (Office) \+ Work From Home flexibility
* **Employment Type:** Full\-time

**Compensation**

* Salary: 20000 to 35000
* Incentives: Performance\-based (if applicable)

**Why Join CoachX.Live?**

* Fast\-growing startup environment
* High ownership and learning opportunities
* Direct impact on hiring and student success
* Growth\-oriented culture

Job Type: Permanent

$11 trillion of money flows every year between companies in India. It typically takes an average of 70 days for a business to get paid, and this number is increasing by \~5% every year. Formal funding options remain limited, covering less than 5% of the addressable market.


At **CashFlo**, we are building India’s largest **B2B Payments Platform**, transforming how businesses pay and get paid. Our award\-winning platform processes **₹20,000\+ Crores of invoices every month**, serving **300,000\+ MSMEs and 1,200\+ corporates**, with **30\+ lenders** integrated into the ecosystem.


You will join a core team of ex\-BCG, ISB, and IIM alumni, backed by **Elevation Capital** and **General Catalyst**, with deep lineage in financial services via our NBFC roots. We are a team of problem solvers building a technology\-first company with a strong product mindset.


If you enjoy solving real customer problems, working across systems, and owning outcomes end\-to\-end — we want to talk to you.

We are looking for a **Forward Deployment Engineer** to lead customer onboarding, deployments, and production support for the CashFlo platform.


This role sits at the intersection of **engineering, customer success, and product**, and requires strong technical depth combined with excellent communication skills. You will work directly with enterprise customers to ensure fast, reliable deployments and long\-term technical success.


This is **not a traditional support role** — it’s a high\-ownership, hands\-on techno\-support and deployment engineering role.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Customer Deployment \& Onboarding**

* Own **end\-to\-end deployment** of the CashFlo platform for enterprise customers
* Configure integrations, workflows, and environment\-specific setups
* Drive **fast go\-live** and post\-deployment stabilization

### **Customer Interaction \& Requirement Gathering**

* Act as the **primary technical point of contact** for customers
* Understand customer business flows, data needs, and system constraints
* Translate requirements into clear technical inputs for Product and Engineering teams

### **Production Support (L1 \& L2\)**

* Handle **L1/L2 production support** for customer\-reported issues

### **Data \& ETL Support**

* Understand and troubleshoot **ETL pipelines and data workflows**
* Support ingestion, transformation, validation, and reconciliation of data
* Work with APIs, databases, and file\-based integrations

### **Product Feedback \& Documentation**

* Share real\-world customer feedback, gaps, and edge cases with Product teams
* Create deployment guides, runbooks, and internal documentation

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 4–8 years of experience in **customer\-facing technical roles**
* Strong understanding of **ETL pipelines and data workflows**
* Experience working with **AWS, GCP, or Azure** cloud environments
* Knowledge of cloud networking fundamentals
* Knowledge of Java \- SprintBoot/Python, Postgres is a must.
* Familiarity with **SQL**, APIs, monitoring, and logging tools
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent **written and verbal communication** skills

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience with SaaS, FinTech, or enterprise platforms
* Prior roles in **Solutions Engineering, Deployment Engineering, or Technical Support (L2/L3\)**
* Startup or high\-growth environment experience

title: HR manager (AI aware)
description:
**Job Title :** 
 HR Manager (AI aware)
 



  





 An AI\-Aware Human Resource Manager is a strategic professional who integrates artificial intelligence technologies into HR functions to enhance efficiency, data\-driven decision\-making, and employee experience, while managing ethical considerations. Unlike traditional HR roles focused solely on administrative tasks, this role leverages AI for recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and workforce analytics, allowing the manager to focus on high\-touch human interactions.
 



**Core Job Responsibilities** 



* **Strategic AI Implementation:** 
 Evaluates and integrates AI tools (e.g., chatbots, ATS, analytics) to automate routine processes like payroll, benefits administration, and initial resume screening.
* **Talent Acquisition \& Sourcing:** 
 Uses generative AI to craft job descriptions, generate tailored interview questions, and source candidates from diverse databases.
* **Data\-Driven Decision Making:** 
 Analyzes workforce data using predictive analytics to forecast talent needs, identify turnover trends, and address skills gaps.
* **AI\-Enabled Performance Management:** 
 Oversees AI tools that aggregate feedback, track goals in real\-time, and suggest customized training plans.
* **Employee Experience \& Onboarding:** 
 Personalizes the onboarding process using AI, guiding new hires through paperwork, and answering FAQs via virtual assistants, ensuring 24/7 support.
* **Ethics \& Governance:** 
 Ensures AI tools are used ethically, mitigating algorithmic bias in screening and performance evaluation, and maintaining compliance with data privacy regulations.
* **Change Management:** 
 Leads the cultural shift toward human\-AI collaboration, upskilling the HR team on AI literacy and addressing workforce concerns regarding technology.



**Key Skills \& Competencies** 



* **AI Literacy \& Fluency:** 
 Understanding of Generative AI, Conversational AI, and Machine Learning applications in HR.
* **Data Literacy:** 
 Ability to interpret data generated by AI to make proactive workforce decisions.
* **Strategic Thinking \& Change Leadership:** 
 Guiding organizational transformation, rather than just using tools.
* **Human\-Centric Approach:** 
 Blending AI\-driven insights with empathy and human judgment for talent decisions.

* Provide support to the business leaders and counsellors in the implementation of engagement initiatives across the business unit
* Anticipate issues and needs within the business unit and address these effectively
* Provide insight on people issues, particularly ER (Employee Relations) cases within business unit, provide a robust point of view on business decisions and their impact upon people
* Ensure that all necessary people management and development activity required to support the business unit is delivered in the most professional and effective manner
* Execute innovative HR programs
* Ensure resolution of HR related issues and handle these effectively within the given timeline, involving the Employee Relation Talent function where required or expected
* Facilitate change and support the implementation and successful adoption of special projects and initiatives in the business unit, for example: Performance Management, Talent transformation, Talent Development and Reward exercises
* Ensure compliance to local regulations and manage risks (e.g., performance management risk)


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong business acumen and commercial awareness, ability to develop clear, actionable plans in support of an overall business unit strategy
* Ability to engage and influence others, with good change management skills and a desire to act as a change agent
* Strong clients focus with the ability to build good relationships with multiple stakeholders across the organisation at all levels
* Strong Employee Relations experience of complex disciplinary, grievance and performance management activities, especially with employees in senior management/leadership level
* Develop strong relationship with other Talent Centre of Excellence teams to ensure that centrally developed products and initiatives meet the requirements of the business unit
* Ability to work with ambiguity and build consensus across diverse, often global, groups


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Graduate or a post graduate qualification in a Business or Human Resource discipline is desirable.
* 6\-8 years of proven HR generalist experience (e.g., performance management, employee relations
* Relevant working experience in delivering / managing talent initiatives


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience working in a consulting organization or in a similar professional services environment
* Experience of working in a cross\-border, virtual environment would be beneficial


**What We Look For**
* Keen interest to invest time for self\-learning, seeking opportunities to work on cross\-functional HR projects
* Working collaboratively in a team environment
* A self\-starter, independent\-thinker, curious and creative person with desire and passion


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland, and the UK (United Kingdom) – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We will introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills, and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Vice President – Human Resources (VP HR)
description:
**Job Title: Vice President – Human Resources (VP HR)**
**Location:** 
 Noida / NCR
   

  

**Work Mode:** 
 5 Days Working \| Onsite
   

  

**CTC:** 
 ₹20 LPA – ₹30 LPA
   

  

**Experience Required:** 
 7 – 15 Years
   

  

**Industry Preference:** 
 Construction / EPC / Infrastructure / Real Estate / Civil Engineering
   

  

**Position Overview**
 We are seeking an accomplished
 **Vice President – Human Resources** 
 to lead the complete Human Resource function for a fast\-growing construction business, including
 **corporate office HR, project/site HR operations, industrial relations, labour law compliance, talent acquisition, employee engagement, payroll governance, statutory compliance, performance management, and organizational development** 
 .
   

  

 The ideal candidate must come with strong exposure to
 **Construction / Civil Engineering / EPC workforce management** 
 , including handling large blue\-collar manpower, contractual labour, engineers, architects, project managers, and vendor workforce.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities** 
**1\. Strategic HR Leadership**
* Develop and execute HR strategies aligned with the company’s growth plans and project expansion roadmap.
* Partner closely with leadership team, project heads, and business stakeholders to drive people agenda.
* Build HR policies, SOPs, workforce planning models, and talent retention frameworks.
* Lead organization restructuring, manpower budgeting, and succession planning.


* Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning
* Drive end\-to\-end recruitment for:
+ Civil Engineers
+ Site Engineers
+ Project Managers
+ Architects
+ Procurement Teams
+ QS/Billing Engineers
+ Corporate Functions
+ Blue Collar / Contract Labour Workforce

* Design mass hiring strategies for project mobilization across multiple sites.
* Develop recruitment vendor ecosystem and labour supply channels.
* Ensure TAT adherence and manpower fulfillment as per project deadlines.
* Labour Law Compliance \& Industrial Relations (Mandatory)
* Ensure strict adherence to all applicable labour laws and statutory regulations relevant to construction industry.
* Manage:
+ Contract Labour compliance
+ Minimum Wages Act
+ Bonus Act
+ Gratuity Act
+ EPF / ESIC
+ Shops \& Establishment
+ BOCW compliance
+ Factory/Project Site labour obligations

* Liaise with labour departments, government bodies, inspectors, PF/ESIC authorities.
* Handle labour disputes, union matters, disciplinary actions, grievance redressal, and legal notices.
* Ensure vendor manpower statutory compliance and audit governance.
* HR Operations \& Employee Lifecycle Management
* Oversee complete employee onboarding, documentation, induction, transfers, promotions, and exits.
* Build HRMS processes and employee data governance.
* Ensure attendance, leave, payroll inputs, F\&F settlement, and personnel record management.
* Standardize HR operations across HO and all project locations.
* Performance Management \& Organizational Development
* Design KPI/KRA\-based PMS systems for engineering, project delivery, and corporate teams.
* Drive leadership development, competency mapping, and performance review cycles.
* Implement training and development initiatives for technical and non\-technical workforce.
* Create employee engagement and retention programs.
* Compensation, Payroll \& Benefits Governance
* Benchmark salary structures within construction and infrastructure industry.
* Manage payroll approvals, bonus structures, incentives, site allowances, and labour wage disbursement controls.
* Monitor compensation cost optimization without affecting productivity.
* Site HR \& Project Workforce Management
* Ensure smooth HR functioning across multiple active construction sites.
* Build site HR reporting systems and project manpower dashboards.
* Coordinate with project directors for labour deployment, contractor workforce, attendance discipline, and grievance handling.
* Conduct periodic site visits for compliance and employee relations monitoring.
* Policy Formulation \& Compliance Audits
* Draft and implement HR handbook, disciplinary policies, POSH, whistleblower, travel, leave, attendance, and contractor engagement policies.
* Conduct periodic statutory and internal HR audits.
* Ensure zero non\-compliance risk in labour inspections and client audits.


**Mandatory Candidate Requirements**
* Full\-time MBA/PGDM in HR / Personnel Management / Industrial Relations preferred.
* Must have 7–15 years of core HR experience, with substantial exposure in Construction / EPC / Infrastructure / Civil Engineering companies.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of Labour Laws \& Industrial Relations is mandatory.
* Proven experience in handling both white\-collar and large blue\-collar workforce.
* Experience in multi\-site/project\-based employee management.
* Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and decision\-making skills.
* Comfortable with onsite working from Noida/NCR office and project visits.


**Preferred Industry Background**
 Candidates from:
   

  

* Construction Developers
* EPC Companies
* Civil Contracting Firms
* Infrastructure Organizations
* Real Estate Project Companies
* Manufacturing units with heavy labour management


**Key Skills Required**
* Strategic HR Management
* Construction HR
* Labour Law Compliance
* Industrial Relations
* Contract Labour Management
* Statutory Compliance
* Talent Acquisition
* Payroll Governance
* PMS/KRA/KPI
* HR Operations
* Employee Engagement
* Site HR Management
* Vendor Workforce Compliance


**Compensation \& Benefits**
* Salary Range: ₹20,00,000 – ₹30,00,000 per annum
* 5 Days Working
* Leadership Role with Growth Opportunity


**Location**
 Noida / NCR (Work from Office \+ Site Travel as required)
   

  

 Skills: statutory compliance,hr operations,employee engagement,industrial relations,strategic hr management,payroll governance,construction hr,pms/kra/kpi,site hr management,contract labour management,talent acquisition,labour law compliance

title: Human Factors Engineer
description:
The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies.
   

  

 Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever\-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.
   

  

**About The Position**
 Chevron ENGINE has an exciting opportunity for a Human Factors Engineer to join the Project Design Engineering team. Reporting to the Manager Project design Engineering, this role will be based in Chevron’s office in Bengaluru.
   

  

 The Human Factors Engineer supports the Projects Design Engineering team within the Chevron ENGINE Center, partnering with facilities engineers and other disciplines to ensure designs meet Safety in Design (SID) requirements and quality expectations across Chevron’s oil and gas facilities. The role guides Pre\-FEED execution and delivery of Digital Design Packages in a collaborative environment.
   

  

 Chevron ENGINE supports global operations, and work hours are aligned to business needs. Standard working hours are 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM or 1:30 PM to 10:30 PM, Monday to Friday. These may evolve based on operational or business requirements.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Applies Safety in Design \& Human Factors Engineering (HFE) in a design \& execution environment for the enterprise.
* Develop \& execute HFE implementation plans, including design studies to address health, safety, operability, reliability and maintainability.
* Develop and apply Company requirements and local regulations in a petrochemical environment.
* Undertake root cause analysis of HFE related issues.
* Develop workable solutions as they apply to HFE and Safety in Design problems.
* Resolve complex technical issues related to HFE and mentor others in doing so.
* Ensure that full consideration of personal safety and environmental factors are incorporated into facility designs.
* Lead assigned HFE scopes based on business needs, including:
+ Managing Chevron Engineering Standards to align with industry standards and supplier specifications.
+ Participate in 3D model design review activities, including oversight of engineering contractors as needed.
+ Executing site based and remote Human Factors Engineering reviews of facilities that are in construction using established tools and procedures.
+ Supporting the Facilities and Operations of the Future (FOF) program delivering digital solutions across the enterprise

* Interface with cross\-functional technical development groups and FE teams; communicate effectively across organizational levels.
* It is anticipated that domestic and international travel, or in some cases, Temporary Domestic Assignments of up to 24 months at engineering contractor’s offices will be required.


**About You**
 We know our greatest resource is the ingenuity, creativity and innovation of our people. Applications from motivated, talented individuals with a keen interest in the energy industry are encouraged.
   

  

**To Be Considered For This Role, Applicants Should Have**
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant engineering discipline (Human Factors/Ergonomics, Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation/Controls, Process Controls, or Process) from a deemed/recognized (AICTE) university.
* Experience in one or more of the following phases: Pre\-FEED, FEED, Detailed Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Startup, and Operations.
* Strong knowledge of system interfaces, systems engineering, and project execution.
* Experience working on multi\-disciplinary teams of engineers and CAD designers to deliver quality Engineering Design Packages/FEED packages while managing scope, cost, schedule, and risk.
* 5–10 years of experience in Human Factors Engineering for design engineering, execution or consultant role within offshore, complex LNG or power generation facilities.
* Operations and facility commissioning/startup experience.
* Project engineering and fabrication experience on larger capital projects within oil and gas.


**What We Can Offer You**
 Everything we do at Chevron is guided by our values and our commitment to The Chevron Way.
   

  

 Have the opportunity to take part in world\-leading energy projects, advance your professional development and expand your career within an inclusive and collaborative workplace.
   

  

* Join a workplace where innovation, collaboration and safety are at the core of how we work.
* Work in thoughtfully designed environments that support focus, well\-being, and innovation enhanced by digital tools that enable seamless collaboration.
* Grow through structured learning, mentorship, and opportunities to contribute to impactful projects that align with Chevron’s values and business priorities.
* Access comprehensive benefits that support your health, well\-being, and work\-life balance.
* Engage with emerging technologies and digital solutions that are shaping the future of energy and enterprise.


**How To Apply**

 **APPLY** 
 to submit your application.
   

  

 Chevron regrets that it is unable to sponsor employment Visas or consider individuals on time\-limited Visa status for this position.

title: Network Engineer
description:
Join our forward\-thinking team as a Network Engineer, where you will play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting high\-performance, low\-latency network infrastructure.
   

  

 At IMC, the Trading Infrastructure team is responsible for the WAN, LANs, and all low\-latency connectivity to trading venues. You will work closely with Systems Engineers, internal teams, and external partners to deliver best\-in\-class solutions that support our trading business and help evolve our infrastructure to meet the demands of a dynamic industry.
   

  

**Your Core Responsibilities**
* Design, implement and support the networking infrastructure. Key areas include Low\-latency networking, Unicast and Multicast routing, OSPF, BGP, PIM SM, as well as things like QoS, STP, NAT, protocol tuning, etc.
* Monitor, guard and analyze the proper functioning of our network infrastructure. Take adaptive, retentive and corrective measures and perform structural maintenance.
* Proactively improve our infrastructure by contributing scripts and code to our automation efforts (e.g. Bash, Python).
* Accurately create and maintain documentation detailing the implemented network components, as well as relevant procedures and other documentation.
* Responsibility for our IT security related platforms. Key areas include Palo Alto firewalls, VPNs, Security policies, etc.
* Work flexible hours. We are proud of the uptime of the trading environment, so every now and then you will be working outside of regular business hours to apply critical changes. This could be from your desk, your couch at home or also inside of one of our datacenters abroad.
* Liaise with external vendors, exchanges and providers to explore new technology solutions, implement new services or troubleshoot problems.


**Your Skills And Experience**
* 5\+ years of experience as a Network Engineer, with a passion for all aspects of networking
* Proven ability to design, implement, and support high\-performance networks
* Strong appetite for accuracy and willingness to go beyond standard textbook networking concepts
* Collaborative mindset with experience working closely across cross\-functional teams
* Ability to motivate and encourage peers while maintaining a high technical standard
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical topics to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders


**About Us**
 IMC is a global trading firm powered by a cutting\-edge research environment and a world\-class technology backbone. Since 1989, we’ve been a stabilizing force in financial markets, providing essential liquidity upon which market participants depend. Across our offices in the US, Europe, Asia Pacific, and India, our talented quant researchers, engineers, traders, and business operations professionals are united by our uniquely collaborative, high\-performance culture, and our commitment to giving back. From entering dynamic new markets to embracing disruptive technologies, and from developing an innovative research environment to diversifying our trading strategies, we dare to continuously innovate and collaborate to succeed.

description:
**Company**
 Qualcomm India Private Limited
   

  

**Job Area**
 Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Systems Test Engineering
   

  

**General Summary**
 The WLAN Performance Test Engineer is responsible for validating the throughput, latency, RF performance of Wi\-Fi products and Power efficiency under various real\-world and lab conditions. The role ensures compliance with IEEE 802\.11 standards and identifies performance bottlenecks at PHY/MAC layers.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Performance Validation
* Conduct throughput testing using tools such as iPerf, IxChariot, octoScope, Spirent, or IXIA.
* Validate performance across different Wi\-Fi standards (802\.11ac/ax/be).
* Measure PHY data rate, throughput, Packet loss, Jitter, Latency, retransmission rate
* RF \& OTA (Over\-the\-Air) Testing
* Perform RF validation including RvR, RSSI, SNR,Adjacent channel interference
* Simulate customer field environment and test performance with different devices including iOS, Mac, Android, Windows
* Execute testing inside shield boxes or anechoic chambers.
* Load \& Scalability Testing
* Validate performance under high client density scenarios.
* Simulate concurrent traffic (VoIP, video streaming, web traffic).
* Interference Testing
* Test performance under co\-channel and adjacent channel interference.
* Evaluate performance in 2\.4GHz, 5GHz, and 6GHz bands.
* Automation \& Scripting
* Develop automation scripts using C Sharp, Python.
* Automate log collection, KPI extraction and triaging.
* Debug \& Root Cause Analysis
* Analyze packet captures (Wireshark).
* Interpret logs from AP, STA, and driver layers.
* Work with firmware and PHY teams for issue resolution.

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree
* Wireless Protocols: Strong understanding of IEEE 802\.11 standards (a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be), OFDM, MIMO, MU\-MIMO, QoS (WMM)
* Tools: Experience with IXIA / Spirent / Keysight test equipment, iPerf, Wireshark
* Networking: Knowledge of TCP/IP stack and preferred experience in Layer 2/Layer 3 networking.

**Position Description:**
 The Network Security Engineer is responsible for assisting with the planning, design, optimization, implementation, audit, and troubleshooting the Barry\-Wehmiller (BW) network from a security perspective to improve the protection and the efficiency of the organization. It is the responsibility of the NST to help plan and implement security measures to protect the system from cyber\-attacks, hacking attacks, intrusion, infiltration, exfiltration and natural disasters at the network level. This individual will help make our company’s information technology (IT) environment more secure by protecting system boundaries, keeping computer systems and network devices hardened against attacks, and securing company and personal data.
   

  

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities (Essential Functions):**
* Assist in planning, identifying, defining, engineering, and monitoring the security arrangements for the protection of the company’s network and services.
* Design secure remote access practices and implementation plans as well as make recommendations to secure BW’s footprint in BW and customer facilities; assist in designing and optimizing security in BW’s Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) initiatives
* Participate in projects to address gaps in BW’s on\-premises and cloud network environments.
* Assist in developing, documenting, and maintaining standard security policy settings for firewalls and other network security devices and appliances.
* Oversee daily operations of BW’s network security systems
* Assist the Infrastructure team with designing and documenting additional network segmentation and enhancing BW’s Information Technology / Operational Technology segregation.
* Manage daily operations of intrusion detection systems as well as ensure the security of firewalls, VPNs, web protocols and other networking equipment.
* Help investigate intrusion and hacking incidents, collect incident responses, and carry out forensic investigations as directed.
* Use industry\-standard analysis criteria to test the security level of the BW enterprise; test and check the BW enterprise for weaknesses in software and hardware by assisting with penetration tests, vulnerability assessments and then managing all findings to resolution.
* Assist with the implementation of regulatory systems in accordance with IT security.
* Help optimize malware and other threat detection systems and processes.
* Collaborate with the Infrastructure team regarding improving design and security capabilities, and determining network security standards and policies.
* Participate in implementation and integration projects such as conducting product research, overseeing proof of concept evaluations, coordinating with the Infrastructure team during acquisition integrations and implementations and overseeing the configuration and installation of security infrastructure devices.
* Configure and maintain systems that log and monitor security threats and alerts.


**Job Specifications:**
* Knowledge of Cisco and Palo Alto firewalls and other next\-generation firewall technologies.
* Knowledge of Cisco ISE and its capabilities.
* Knowledge of Cisco Meraki.
* Knowledge of Netskope
* Knowledge of routing and switching capabilities.
* Strong logical ability, natural curiosity, problem solving ability, good oral and written communication skills, thorough, takes initiative, professional appearance/demeanor, dependable, flexible with schedule, loyal, organized, and courteous.
* Troubleshooting skills with networking and computer systems, can multitask, work in a fast\- paced environment while providing excellent user experience.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**GWS Tech Support Agent**
 As a GWS L1 Support Agent, you are the first responder for all employee inquiries related to communication and collaboration tools. You will provide technical support for Gmail, Drive, Docs, Meet, and Calendar, ensuring that users can work seamlessly across devices. Your primary goal is to resolve issues quickly using standard operating procedures (SOPs) and maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**1\. Core Troubleshooting \& SupportAccess \& Identity:** 
 Handle user onboarding/offboarding, password resets, and 2\-Step Verification (2SV) troubleshooting.
   

  

* App\-Specific Support: Resolve common sync issues in Google Drive, "missing" emails in Gmail, and connectivity hurdles in Google Meet.
* Resource Management: Manage shared calendars, room bookings, and Shared Drive permissions for various departments.
* Mobile \& Chrome Support: Assist users in setting up work profiles on Android/iOS and managing Chrome browser extensions.


**2\. Security \& Compliance (Front\-Line)**
* Phishing \& Spam: Act as the first point of contact for users reporting suspicious emails; perform initial header analysis to verify threats.
* Data Privacy: Ensure that file\-sharing settings (Internal vs. Public) comply with company data policies during the support process.
* Account Recovery: Follow strict identity verification protocols before granting access to locked accounts.


**3\. Documentation \& AI Enablement**
* Self\-Service Growth: Direct users to relevant help center articles and create "Quick Start" guides for new Workspace features.
* AI Assistance: Utilize Gemini for Workspace to summarize support tickets, draft clear responses to users, and find solutions within the internal Knowledge Base (KB) faster.

title: Junior Developer
description:
Axi is a leading global provider of margin and deliverable Foreign Exchange, Contracts for Difference (CFDs), and Financial Spread betting. Our business has evolved into a world\-class, multifaceted brokerage with offices in six regions. With heavy investment in the latest trading technology, Axi seeks to offer the most comprehensive end\-to\-end trading experience available, servicing traders of all levels from beginners to institutional\-level clients.
   

  

**About The Team**
 You will be a member of a global POD using .NET Core, C\#, ReactJS, SQL Server, Cosmos DB, messaging, Kubernetes (AKS), and Databricks, Azure. As a Junior Developer, you will support feature development, testing, and operations in a high\-availability environment with guidance and support from senior team members.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Assist in building backend services and REST APIs using .NET Core (C\#), focusing on clean code and basic SOLID principles.
* Write unit and integration tests; contribute to CI/CD pipelines with Docker and Azure tools.
* Work with SQL Server for queries and basic schema design; learn Cosmos DB for NoSQL data handling.
* Integrate simple messaging (Azure Service Bus/Event Grid) for event\-driven features.
* Support observability through logging and monitoring with Application Insights.
* Collaborate with seniors on code reviews, bug fixes, and learning production support basics.


**Why Join Axi**
* Accelerate your growth as a full\-stack engineer on a global trading platform.
* Work with talented engineers and architects who mentor and guide your development.
* Exposure to modern technologies: microservices, Kubernetes, cloud\-native architecture, and fintech.
* Meaningful work with visible impact on a 24/7 platform serving global traders.


**Axi’s Bag of Delights**
* Competitive compensation
* Training, development resources, and certification opportunities
* 18 annual leave days \+ 12 sick days
* Local public holidays
* Health insurance benefits


**Interview Process**
* Talent Acquisition Screen (45 mins)
* Technical Round (60 mins)
* Cultural Fit Round (60 mins)

Your goal is to provide rapid, empathetic, and effective troubleshooting.
