description:
**Business Overview \-** 




  





***About Danone Group:***




  





 Mission: Bringing Health through Food to as Many people as Possible
 



  





 Danone is a global leader in food and beverages, focusing on Essential Dairy and Plant\-based products, Waters, and Specialized Nutrition. Our mission is to bring health through food to as many people as possible by creating nutritious products, raising awareness about healthy eating and drinking habits, and conducting our business sustainably.
 



  





 Danone’s dual focus on commercial performance and societal responsibility, combined with an ongoing commitment to innovation and the strengthening of its health\-oriented brands, has resulted in strong performance worldwide. With nearly 90,000 employees and products sold in over 120 markets, Danone has generated more than €27 billion in sales annually.
 



  





 More information can be found at www.danone.com.
 



  





***About Danone India:***




  





 India is among the countries in the APAC zone wherein Danone has its presence. Danone operates in India as Nutricia International Pvt. Ltd, focusing on nutrition with a range of products catering to pregnant mothers, infants, young children as well as adults. These products are manufactured in India and sold nationally under recognized brands such as Aptamil, Dexolac, Nusobee, and Protinex. Danone employs over 1,000 individuals across India and generates a turnover exceeding €170 million. The company's head office is in Mumbai, Maharashtra, with a manufacturing facility situated in Lalru, Punjab.
 



  





 Danone India is a Great Place To Work® certified organization, which reflects our commitment to creating a workplace where people are empowered to contribute meaningfully, grow professionally, and feel a true sense of belonging.
 



  





 More information can be found at https://www.danone.in/
 



  





 Want to learn more about Careers at Danone India? Visit Danone Careers
 



  





**Role and Responsibilities:** 




  





 The HR Business Partner would be engaging with business stakeholders in key HR processes including head count requirement, performance management, people coaching, development conversations, coordinating learning activities, PDR and ASR process facilitation and all HR strategic projects implementation. The HRBP would also be responsible for managing employee relations and union management (if applicable in the Line of Business) which will involve discipline and grievances management, participating in domestic inquiries, managing litigations under various labor laws (if applicable), bottom quartile management and others related activities. Improving existing practices to ensure high \& positive internal employee experience would be key to the role. Collaborating with CBU HR teams for alignment and implementation of HR processes and sharing feedback for process improvements.
 



  





**Human Resources Management** 




  





*Performance Management*



* Deploy Danone People Conversations (C1 to C5\) in line with global processes and complete HR audits.
* Coordinate and manage Performance related processes Performance Calibration, Annual Salary Review and Short\-term Incentives payouts (STI)
* Discuss with line leaders on employee performance matters and plan for employees’ promotions/performance coaching
* Consolidate performance reviews with functional heads and give consolidated data and recommendations
* Coordinate and track PIP plans for bottom quartile performers







*Headcount Management*



* Partner with business leaders for understanding optimal headcount and positions, talent needs identification in line with business goals
* Manage headcount optimization based on business needs
* Partner with business for internal transfers and assessment of talent pool to meet re\-organization needs
* Coordinate and oversee field force hiring as per process and business need







*Talent*



* Deploy IJP process to identify internal talent as per business requirements
* Contribute to talent needs identification and job requisition on sHaRe for managerial population ICIMS, and participate in the interview process as panel with business stakeholders and share feedback for managerial positions
* Train people managers on all HR Processes (Target setting, PDR, ASR etc.)
* Review re\-hire requests and share feedback







*New Joiner Management*



* Support line managers on designing and planning functional inductions of new joiners (managerial) for early performance impact
* Supporting new joiner in knowing teams, important stakeholders, conducting introduction calls for new joiners
* Run HR sessions during the Basic Training Program (BTP) and induction plans for managers on field



  





  





*Attrition and Exit Management*



* Identification of attrition risks through EWS and create mitigation plan to ensure talent availability.
* Monthly attrition analysis with business stakeholders and creating action plan to manage attrition
* Manage exit process along with line leaders, engaging in retention conversations, negotiations, exit interviews etc.
* Advise business leaders on retention strategies for key talent and support on attrition management



  





*HR Policies*



* Suggesting improvements and leading changes in HR Policies and processes from time to time for enhancing employee experience
* Ensure implementation of HR policies and guidelines for the lines of business supported



  





*Rewards and Recognition*



* Co\-ordinate with people managers for R\&R policy and facilitating the process in respective Line of Business (LOB)



  





*Payroll Management*



* Share monthly payroll inputs to central payroll team
* Managing grievances with payroll team related to payroll\-Sodexo, Mediclaim etc.
* Share resignation details and F\&F inputs with payroll team and other stakeholders



  









**Employee Relations and Social Fundamentals** 




  





*Discipline Management*



* Investigate and take appropriate actions\- issue show cause notices \& charge sheets, termination letters etc.\- for noncompliance or disciplinary issues based on investigation reports
* Manage disciplinary issues in the line of business and address employee grievances
* Coach and advise line managers to enable them with strategies of discipline management
* Prepare and participate in domestic inquiries and labor court hearings as and when required



  





*Union Management*



* Manage Union matters and related grievances, demands, expectations
* Co\-ordinate with legal consultants on case\-to\-case basis and guidance



  





  





**Employee Connect and Engagement** 




  





*Engagement Surveys*



* Drive all surveys (Danone People Survey, Pulse survey etc.) and ensure maximum participation
* Create customized action plan based on survey results and employee feedback
* Validate the action plan with functional CODIs for deployment



  





*Employee Connects*



* Regular connect with employees, people managers and functional CODIs to understand areas of opportunities and way forward
* Deploy HR brown bags to gather employee feedback
* Partner with Safety Manager to deploy Health and wellbeing initiatives



  





**Candidate Profile** 




  




* MBA from a Tier\-1 B\-School
* 3 to 5 years of relevant experience post MBA

 is a network of five interconnected business\-function hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally.  Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.
 










  




**Job Summary** 






  



 We are seeking a strategic and hands\-on HR Business Partner to support two critical dimensions of our organization:
 








  


* Serving as the HR Business Partner for the Executive Assistant (EA) and Management Assistant (MA) population across Asia Pacific (APAC) (50%), and
* Leading HR for our Global Business Services (GBS) Kuala Lumpur office, (50%).







  




 This role operates in a highly matrixed, multi\-country environment and requires balancing regional strategic priorities with local operational excellence. The individual will act as a trusted advisor to business and program leadership, driving talent strategy, employee experience, and organizational effectiveness, while ensuring strong governance and compliance.
 








  




**Principal Accountabilities and % of time** 









  




**1\. Regional HR Business Partner – APAC EA/MA Program (\~50%)**

**2\. GBS HR Lead – GBS Kuala Lumpur (\~50%)**

* Act as a trusted advisor to office leadership, shaping talent strategy, workforce planning, and organizational effectiveness for the KL office.
* Lead all local employee relations, compliance, and regulatory matters, ensuring effective risk management and alignment with local labor laws and statutory requirements.
* Helping to shape a strong office culture and employee experience, including engagement, wellbeing, and inclusion initiatives tailored to the KL environment.







  




**3\. Talent Management, Rewards \& Organizational Effectiveness**









  


* Advise leaders on performance management, promotions, and compensation decisions across both scopes.
* Analyze engagement survey results and partner with the business to drive targeted action plans to improve employee experience and retention.
* Support organizational design, role clarity, and capability building initiatives.




  
 





**4\. Employee Relations \& Risk Management**









  


* Provide oversight and guidance on employee relations matters across APAC EA/MA and direct ownership for KL\-based cases.
* Ensure alignment between global standards and local legal requirements through close partnership with local HR and Legal teams.
* Proactively identify and mitigate HR\-related risks while balancing business needs and employee experience.


* Lead investigations and disciplinary processes in the GBS KL office with sensitivity and professionalism, ensuring fairness and compliance.
* Partner with local HR teams across APAC to ensure consistent handling of ER matters while maintaining compliance with local regulations.




  
 





**5\. HR**


**Activities** 


**, Projects \& Continuous Improvement**









  


* Lead and support the implementation of global HR initiatives, projects, and transformation efforts.
* Drive process improvements and operational efficiencies across HR service delivery.
* Leverage data, analytics, and emerging tools to enhance decision\-making and HR impact.


* Champion employee wellbeing, engagement, and workplace safety initiatives for the KL GBS Office, embedding them into day\-to\-day operations
* Act as key liaison with relevant government agencies where required, including managing in\-person engagements, ensuring timely submission and filing of statutory documentation, and staying up to date with evolving local laws and regulatory requirements to maintain full compliance.
* Ensure consistent, high\-quality HR support with a strong client\-service mindset.
* Manage benefits administration and support implementation of benefits strategies and vendor transitions at the GBS KL office.
* Advise the business on policy matters, ensuring compliance with internal policies and local labor regulations for the GBS KL population.







  




**6\. Team Leadership \& Development**









  


* Manage, coach, and develop direct reports (e.g., HR Specialist), ensuring strong execution of local HR operations and capability building.


* Foster a high\-performance, collaborative, and learning\-oriented HR team environment.







  




 In addition to the responsibilities outlined above, this role may be required to support or lead additional initiatives, projects, or activities aligned with business needs and the evolving HR agenda
 








  




**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** 









  


* Strong business acumen and ability to translate business needs into HR strategies
* Proven ability to operate in a complex, matrixed, multi\-country environment
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, including with senior leaders
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands\-on execution
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to derive insights from data

**Experience**

title: HR Manager (Talent Management)
description:
The Human Resources Manager (Talent Management) drives initiatives to support a culture of learning and development at Husco. This position will drive and maintain effective programs for employee attraction, retention, promotion, and succession planning. The Human Resources Manager (Talent Management) will be responsible for talent attraction including pipeline development, agency partnership, and recruitment as well as design, develop, deliver, and maintain all employee development, oversee employee reviews, manage succession planning conversations and other programming. They will be responsible for supporting and improving a culture that attracts and retains a talented, engaged, high\-performing workforce.
   

  

**Key Job Responsibilities**
* Attracts the Top Talent in our Industry. Coordinates recruitment/employment activities for all office positions. Attracts, develops, retains and motivates employees at all levels. Create and maintain a continual/active flow of candidates by utilizing advanced internet searching skills, cold and warm calling, networking, database mining, referrals, social/business websites, and other non\-traditional avenues. Engage in timely and appropriate communications with all candidates, hiring managers, recruiting managers, peer recruiters, vendors and other stakeholders to create a highly positive experience. Benchmarks employee compensation and benefits programs and provides feedback in relation to new programs, changes and renewals. Develop and manage the onboarding process for all new employees. This includes facilitating new employee orientation.
* Lead the Local Talent Planning, Critical Roles, and Succession Programs. Drive the local talent planning and succession management process, ensuring alignment with the broader global strategy. This role will partner closely with site leadership to identify critical roles, assess talent readiness, and implement development plans that support long\-term workforce sustainability. The manager will also contribute insights and data to the global talent pipeline, helping shape enterprise\-wide succession strategies and leadership development initiatives.
* Annual Review Process and Coaching: Oversee and administer annual performance review process for all local office employees. Coach managers on writing and conducting effective performance appraisals, and coach employees and managers on creating actionable goals through effective performance and development conversations.
* Function as a cultural steward and engagement of Husco. Implement the annual engagement survey, analyze results, provide data to key stakeholders, and drive action planning for improving employee engagement. Create opportunities throughout the year to promote employee engagement and satisfaction. Facilitate employee milestone moments including onboarding, performance, and separation discussions. Analyze and quantify feedback for trends and actionable changes for organizational improvement. Be available as a ‘voice of reason’ to employees and leaders for career development and coaching moments.
* Design, deliver, and maintain training programs. Lead training programs for India and partner with global HR leaders and training committees to meet organization and employee development needs. Create and deliver or partner with external experts to provide all soft skills, leadership, and technical training. Utilize training validation methods including competency testing and participant evaluations to measure training outcomes. Maintain thorough understanding of industry best practices for employee and leadership development tools and practices. Identify learning offerings and participate in the selection of vendors, suppliers and other contracted resources.
* Strong Team Player and Contributor. Able to work well with colleagues and produce results within a fast\-paced and high\-pressure atmosphere. Combines strong attention to detail with an orientation towards results/execution. Assist with the maintenance and interpretation of all company policies, employee handbooks, and on\-boarding and orientation materials. Provide support as needed to Human Resource team members to assure the attainment of departmental objectives.


**Qualifications/Requirements**
* Bachelor’s Degree in human resource or a related field
* 8\+ years of work experience in human resources, specifically in talent development and recruiting.
* Experience driving talent initiatives and building relationships that gain buy\-in and commitment to the value of learning initiatives.
* Experience sourcing and recruiting technical professionals, specifically engineers and IT professionals.
* Ability to organize and prioritize multiple tasks; manage and meet deadlines. Project management experience is a plus.
* Ability to establish credibility and build collaborative partnerships with all levels of management and individuals across a broad range of business groups.
* Experience in aligning projects, tasks and goals with departmental and organizational strategy.
* Proficiency in verbal and written English

At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high\-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 70,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.
   

  

 Could you be the full\-time Human Resources Manager in Channi we’re looking for?
   

  

**Your future role**
 Take on a new challenge and apply your comprehensive HR expertise in a new cutting\-edge field. You’ll work alongside dedicated and supportive teammates.
   

  

 You'll provide professional HR support to local business partners, ensuring adherence to company policy and the deployment of Alstom HR initiatives. Day\-to\-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (such as administration, payroll, and talent management), counsel business on HR topics and much more.
   

  

 You’ll specifically take care of implementing business/corporate/group HR strategy, but also supervise and lead local HR to deliver day\-to\-day operational support.
   

  

 We’ll look to you for:
   

  

* Counseling business partners on HR topics and strategies
* Ensuring project staffing and site HR support
* Developing and implementing policies and practices in alignment with market trends
* Driving performance management systems and development activities
* Managing the annual People Review and ensuring feedback to individuals
* Overseeing recruitment, retention of high performers, and key positions


**All About You**
 We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
   

  

* University degree in human resources, psychology, business studies, social science, or economy
* Experience or understanding of HR management in a similar industry/environment
* Knowledge of employment law, redundancies, payroll, and employee relations

* A MBA with a specialization in HR Organization Development (desirable)

* Enjoy stability, challenges and a long\-term career free from boring daily routines

* Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
* Contribute to innovative projects
* Utilise our flexible working environment
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
* Benefit from our investment in your development, through award\-winning learning

* Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)

Ready to push the limits of what’s possible? Join Sanofi’s talent team and you can play a vital role in the performance of our entire business while helping to make an impact on millions around the world. As an Early Careers Talent Management Specialist, you will play a crucial role in supporting early career talent at Sanofi, by implementing our early career programs.

  

We are an innovative global healthcare company with one purpose: to chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives. We’re also a company where you can flourish and grow your career, with countless opportunities to explore, make connections with people, and stretch the limits of what you thought was possible. Ready to get started?

 **About Sanofi:**


We’re an R\&D\-driven, AI\-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

 **Main responsibilities:**

* Meticulously track the progress of early career talent throughout their programs (e.g., internships, apprenticeships), monitoring performance metrics, rotation completions, and key milestones.
* Track early career performance data, including performance reviews, feedback, and other relevant metrics.
* Serve as a point of contact for early career participants, providing guidance, answering questions, and escalating issues to program managers as needed.
* Maintain regular communication with participants, ensuring they feel supported and informed throughout their program journey.
* Utilize data analysis and continuous improvement methodologies to identify program trends, assess program effectiveness, and recommend enhancements to optimize the participant experience and program outcomes.
* Provide administrative and logistical support for early career programs, including scheduling meetings, coordinating events, preparing materials, and managing program documentation.
* Relay insights to talent management teams to identify high\-potential individuals and potential areas for program improvement.
* Coordinate with early career program stakeholders to facilitate smooth transitions between rotations, ensuring alignment with program objectives and individual development goals.

 **About you**


You are a highly motivated individual and passionate about contributing to the development of Sanofi's early career talent pipeline and fostering a culture of growth and opportunity. You will provide essential administrative, logistical, and coordination support, ensuring a seamless and positive experience for program participants and stakeholders.

 **Experience**

* Have experience in program coordination, HR analytics, or talent management, with demonstrated ability to track and analyse data sets
* Excel/data visualization tools and managing multiple participant cohorts simultaneously is essential
* Ability to identify process inefficiencies, recommend enhancements, and maintain meticulous records while managing multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment

 **Soft and technical skills**

* Strong program management and administrative skills
* Excellent coordination and logistical support
* Strong written and verbal communication skills

description:

**Responsibilities**
**Executive Support \& Project Management (50%)**
* Serve as strategic execution partner to the Central Europe HR Leadership Team, translating priorities into actionable plans and ensuring follow\-through
* Track and monitor progress of critical Central European HR initiatives and projects across multiple countries
* Drive accountability for delivery milestones across regional initiatives, ensuring timely completion of key priorities
* Organize and manage logistics for regional leadership meetings, including scheduling, agenda preparation, and materials distribution
* Contribute to the facilitation of regional meetings and produce detailed action notes with systematic follow\-up tracking
* Follow up with country HR teams, CoEs, and Experience Delivery model stakeholders on project deliverables, timelines, and action items
* Maintain project dashboards and status reports for leadership visibility in collaboration with the CoE Data Management team
* Ensure compliance with global HR policies across regional initiatives and programs \[MK1] \[RM2]
* Serve as key engagement liaison between Central Europe HR and global HR Centers of Excellence (Mobility, Compensation \& Benefits, Learning \& Development, HR Systems \[MK3] \[RM4] )
* Provide firm yet supportive follow\-up to ensure stakeholders meet commitments and deadlines


**Talent Acquisition Market Research \& Intelligence (35%)**
* Conduct comprehensive market research and competitive intelligence for talent acquisition across Central European markets under the guidance of the Head of TA for Central Europe.
* Perform internal and external talent mapping to identify potential candidates and skill availability by country and function
* Support the Head of Talent Acquisition with data\-driven insights on hiring trends, salary benchmarking, and talent availability
* Create talent landscape reports and competitive analysis by role, geography, and industry segment
* Track and analyze recruitment metrics such as time\-to\-fill, source effectiveness, and candidate quality across the region
* Maintain talent intelligence databases and pipelines for critical roles in Central Europe, to inform hiring strategies
* Identify and recommend process improvements to recruitment processes based on market insights and data protection compliance


**Communication \& Stakeholder Management (15%)**
* Develop compelling, conceptually sound presentations using PowerPoint, Canva, and Mural etc that effectively communicate complex information to leadership and stakeholders
* Design presentation content that tells a clear story, synthesizes data into actionable insights, and supports strategic decision\-making
* Build and maintain strong relationships with Head of Talent Acquisition, Head of Northern Europe, and Head of Southern and Western Europe
* Ensure clear and timely communication of global policy updates and compliance requirements to regional stakeholders.


**Experience**
**QUALIFICATIONS**
* 5\+ years of progressive HR experience in multinational organizations operating across multiple countries
* Demonstrated experience in multi\-country environments
* Proven track record in project coordination and stakeholder management at senior leadership levels with strong delivery focus
* Ideally experience supporting talent acquisition functions with market research and competitive intelligence
* Background in HR operations, analytics, HRBP roles, or coordination positions with exposure to regional/global projects
* Experience working with HR Centers of Excellence and shared service/Experience Delivery models


**Technical Skills**
* Advanced Excel proficiency and organizational skills including complex formulas (VLOOKUP, INDEX\-MATCH, pivot tables, data validation, conditional formatting), data structuring, and systematic file management
* Exceptional presentation design and conceptual thinking skills using PowerPoint, Canva, Mural, or similar tools—ability to craft compelling narratives and visualize complex information
* Data management and analysis capabilities with strong attention to detail
* Proficiency with HRIS systems ( Ideally Oracle, but Workday, SuccessFactors, or similar platforms also relevant)
* Experience with ATS platforms and recruitment tools
* Comfort with collaboration platforms (Microsoft Teams, Mural)


**Core Competencies**
* Strategic project management and execution with exceptional ability to manage multiple priorities and drive delivery of key milestones
* Firm but supportive stakeholder management style—able to hold people accountable while maintaining positive relationships
* Analytical thinking and data\-driven decision\-making
* Exceptional written and verbal communication in English (REQUIRED)
* Additional European languages are a strong advantage
* Market research capabilities and competitive intelligence gathering
* Highly organized with excellent time management—able to prioritize effectively and meet deadlines consistently
* Cultural agility and understanding of Central European employment markets and business practices
* Proactive problem\-solving with strong initiative and ownership mindset
* Attention to detail with high accuracy standards
* Global policy compliance knowledge and ability to translate policy into regional action


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working in offshore/global delivery models for HR services
* Knowledge of Central European employment laws and talent markets across multiple countries
* HR analytics or talent intelligence certification (e.g., LinkedIn Talent Insights, HR Analytics)
* Experience with data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau)
* Familiarity with Agile project management methodologies
* Previous executive support or coordination experience in HR or business functions


**Working Relationships**
* Reports to: Central Europe HR Leadership Team (designated lead)
* Primary Stakeholders:
+ Head of Talent Acquisition \- Central Europe
+ Head of Northern Europe
+ Head of Southern and Western Europe

* Key Partners:
+ Country HR Managers across Central Europe
+ Global HR Centers of Excellence (Talent Management, Compensation \& Benefits, Learning \& Development, HR Systems)
+ Experience Delivery model teams (Shared Services, HR Operations)
+ Offshore and regional HR team members


**Success Metrics**
* Delivery of milestones: Consistent achievement of project timelines and deliverables across regional initiatives
* Quality and actionable insights from talent market research across Central Europe
* Effective meeting facilitation with high follow\-through rates on action items
* Stakeholder satisfaction from Head of TA, Head of Northern Europe, and Head of Southern and Western Europe
* Contribution to talent acquisition effectiveness and time\-to\-fill improvements
* Compliance adherence across regional HR initiatives
* Successful coordination between regional teams, CoEs, and Experience Delivery models
* Quality and impact of presentations and communication materials


**Work Environment \& Location**
* Location: India CSC (specific city to be determined)
* Hybrid remote work model with strong virtual collaboration capabilities
* Working hours: Alignment with Central European time zones where possible

title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
People are the foundation of every successful organization.
 



 The Human Resources Specialist plays a key role in building a positive workplace experience while supporting the organization’s people strategy. This role focuses on talent, employee engagement, and HR operations—ensuring teams feel supported, heard, and empowered to perform at their best.
 



 It’s not just about policies and processes.
 



 It’s about creating an environment where people can thrive.
 



**What This Role Will Focus On** 



* Support recruitment and onboarding processes
* Manage employee relations and HR communications
* Maintain HR records, policies, and compliance standards
* Assist with performance management and employee development initiatives
* Coordinate engagement activities and HR programs
* Provide guidance on HR policies and best practices
* Collaborate with leadership to support workforce planning
* Contribute to building a strong organizational culture



**What Success Looks Like** 



* Smooth and efficient HR operations
* Positive employee engagement and satisfaction
* Strong compliance and accurate HR documentation
* Effective support for managers and teams
* A culture built on trust, transparency, and collaboration



**Skills \& Experience Required** 



* 3–7 years of experience in Human Resources
* Strong understanding of HR operations and employee lifecycle management
* Knowledge of HR policies, compliance, and best practices
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Strong organizational and problem\-solving abilities
* Ability to manage sensitive information with discretion
* Comfortable working independently in a remote environment



**Why This Role Stands Out** 



* Fully remote across India
* Opportunity to shape employee experience and culture
* Exposure to diverse HR initiatives and programs
* Collaborative and growth\-focused environment
* Career progression aligned with people leadership



 This role is for professionals who believe strong organizations start with strong people.
 



 For individuals who enjoy building trust, supporting teams, and solving challenges thoughtfully.
 



 Because great HR doesn’t just manage people.
 



 It empowers them.

title: Training Specialist
description:
**Description**
 Training Specialist Job Description
   

  

 At Amazon, our mission is to be the most customer\-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Amazon Last Mile learning team is seeking training specialist to support operations trainings to last mile vertical. Overall responsibility include boosting the competencies of our employees by developing and conducting effective training programs. The person will indirectly help enhance the employee’s workplace performance in conjunction with the company’s core values to meet the goal of organization. Amazon is an Equal Opportunity\-
   

  

 Trainer Best Behavior
   

  

 1\- Listening to associates and be supportive to managers.
   

  

 2\- Answering requests and always gets back to people.
   

  

 3\- Lead by example, doing what we say and act how we say.
   

  

 4\- Must be approachable.
   

  

 5\- Must exhibit the best behavior while at work.
   

  

 6\- Always be up to date with the latest techniques, tools, and processes.
   

  

 7\- Be right, honest, and be willing to accept mistakes.
   

  

 8\- Be willing to push their limits and accept more responsibilities.

* Supervise structured learning metrices and also oversee their results for the assigned territory and region.
* Managing live performance metrices end to end for the assigned territory.
* Conducting learning session on new process as well as BQM through ITL or digital learning as per the requirement. Deliver various training courses as continuous learning.
* Maintaining data and analysis through reports on excel (as per business requirement)
* Ensure completion of new hire training program, coaching \& other performance improvement programs on time.
* Partners with operations leaders while conducting station audit to check the process compliance and fix the gaps on an immediate basis.
* Identifying learning coaches \& certifying them.
* Lead the individual improvement projects to enhance the business performance.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience with written and verbal communication and presentation
* Experience using Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working with and delivering training/information to Associates and TL level employees

title: SDR SaaS Sales – Fresher
description:
**About Shinkly**

Shinkly Private Limited is a software company building modern SaaS products, including Voidfull \- https://voidfull.com (all\-in\-one content management) and LogChimp \- https://logchimp.app (customer feedback collection).

We focus on building high\-quality, product\-led software and scaling these products to a global audience. As an early\-stage startup, we believe in experimentation, learning quickly, and working closely together to build meaningful products.

**Role Overview**

We’re looking for a **highly driven fresher** who has completed **at least 7 months of internship in tech/SaaS sales** and wants to build a serious career in B2B SaaS.

This is not a “lead gen” role — you’ll get **exposure to the full sales cycle**, working directly with the founder to generate pipeline, talk to prospects, and contribute to closing deals.

If you’re curious, hungry, and willing to learn by doing — this role is for you.

**What You’ll Do**

* Identify and research potential customers (startups, SaaS teams, founders)
* Reach out via cold email, LinkedIn, and other outbound channels
* Qualify inbound and outbound leads
* Conduct initial discovery calls to understand customer pain points
* Support demos and follow\-ups with prospects
* Maintain CRM and track sales pipeline consistently
* Work closely with the founder on messaging, positioning, and GTM experiments
* Share insights from conversations to improve product and sales strategy

**Who Should Apply**

* Fresher with minimum 7 months internship experience in tech/SaaS sales, or BD
* Strong communication skills (written \+ verbal)
* Comfortable talking to new people and handling rejection
* Self\-starter who can work in a fast\-paced, ambiguous environment
* Curious mindset — willing to learn sales by actually doing it
* Basic understanding of SaaS or B2B products

**Good to Have (Not Mandatory)**

* Experience with cold emailing / LinkedIn outreach
* Exposure to CRM tools (HubSpot, Zoho, etc.)
* Experience working in a startup or remote team
* Understanding of Product\-Led Growth (PLG)

**What You’ll Get**

* Hands\-on exposure to real SaaS sales (not just theory)
* Opportunity to work directly with the founder
* Learn full sales cycle — from prospecting to closing
* Fast growth based on performance (not tenure)
* Flexible, remote\-friendly work environment
* Potential transition into a full\-time high\-paying sales role

**Compensation Structure**

Our compensation model is designed for candidates who are confident in their ability to generate pipeline and close deals. To reward performance with strong earning potential and a clear pathway to a fixed base salary.

Phase 1: Ramp\-Up (Commission\-Driven)

* 20% of subscription revenue every month *(starting from the second month)*
* ₹3000 INR bonus on your first deal worth more than $50 USD
* ₹500 INR guarantee for every new deal you close
* No cap on earnings.

This phase gives you a high upside from day one and helps us identify strong performers quickly.

Phase 2: Base Salary \+ Commission

* Unlock a base salary of ₹20,000 INR/month after generating a minimum of $300 USD MRR
* Continued 5–10% upsell commissions
* Future increments possible based on consistent performance

Why This Structure

This aligns with early\-stage startup realities while giving high\-performers a fast path to guaranteed income. Strong performers typically unlock Phase 2 quickly.

**Type:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a sharp, analytically driven individual who thrives on making sense of numbers, processes, and business realities. This role sits at the heart of how we run, improve, and grow our business — and you will be expected to bring structure, curiosity, and a bias for action to everything you do.
   

  

 Reporting directly to the Strategy Consultant, your primary focus will be on ensuring the business unit runs efficiently — tracking performance, strengthening controls, writing and improving processes, and driving operational excellence. Over time, you will also support strategic initiatives including M\&A evaluation and IPO\-related data preparation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Business Unit P\&L \& Operational Performance
* Own the monthly P\&L review process — track revenue lines, cost heads, gross margins, and EBITDA; identify variances against budget and prior periods.
* Prepare detailed MIS reports, financial dashboards, and performance scorecards for leadership on a weekly and monthly basis.
* Analyse trends in revenue, cost, and profitability across business lines, customers, and geographies to surface actionable insights.
* Monitor working capital metrics — debtor days, creditor days, inventory levels, and cash flow patterns — and flag concerns proactively.
* Track and report on key business KPIs; build simple models to forecast performance and test sensitivities.
* Assist in annual budgeting and quarterly re\-forecasting exercises by compiling inputs, challenging assumptions, and preparing consolidated views.
* Design and maintain internal control mechanisms to prevent revenue leakage, cost overruns, and compliance lapses.
* Conduct periodic internal audits of transactions, approvals, and reconciliations; escalate exceptions to the reporting manager.
* Track outstanding receivables and payables; liaise with accounts team to ensure timely closures and accurate books.
* Process Writing \& Continuous Improvement
* Document existing business processes across departments in a structured, clear format — creating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), process flowcharts, and control checklists.
* Identify process gaps, redundancies, and manual workarounds; propose and help implement streamlined alternatives.
* Work with teams on the ground to understand how work actually gets done vs. how it is supposed to get done — and design practical solutions that stick.
* Establish a process review calendar and ensure SOPs are updated periodically to reflect changes in operations, regulations, or systems.
* Track implementation of process improvement initiatives and measure impact through defined metrics (turnaround time, error rates, cost savings, etc.).
* Support automation and digitisation efforts by mapping current processes and identifying candidate workflows for technology intervention.
* Build a centralised process documentation repository accessible to relevant stakeholders.
* Mergers \& Acquisitions (M\&A) Support
* Assist in identifying and profiling potential M\&A targets — compile company overviews, financial summaries, and industry context.
* Build and maintain financial models for deal evaluation — including revenue projections, cost structures, and basic valuation frameworks (DCF, revenue multiples).
* Prepare structured investment briefs and evaluation summaries for presentation to decision\-makers.
* Support due diligence by collating and organising financial data, contracts, regulatory filings, and operational information.

description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience in designing and implementing networking systems.
* 3 years of experience with TCP/IP\-based, routing, and network management protocols.
* Experience in network protocols, architectures, methodologies, and in scripting or programming languages (e.g., Python).


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience with planning and designing large\-scale networks (e.g., multiple sites, multiple products, etc.).
* Experience with Wide Area Network (WAN) technologies, including disaggregated networking or software\-defined networking concepts.
* Experience with modern network management interfaces and protocols (e.g., gRPC, gNMI, OpenConfig).

**About The Job**
 Google is proud to boast a network that provides service to millions of Internet users around the world. The Network Engineering team is responsible for operating that network reliably and at scale. As a member of the team, you have a direct impact on design and feature enhancements to keep our systems running smoothly. You also ensure that network operations are safe and efficient by monitoring network performance, coordinating planned maintenance, adjusting hardware components and responding to network connectivity issues. Google's complex network generates a constant stream of challenges which require you to continually be innovative with an evolving set of technologies. Keeping the network reliable ensures that our users stay connected with our suite of applications, products and services.
   

  

 Google's network provides services to millions of Internet users around the world. Our metros are on the edge of our network where Google connects to its users. The Network Team is responsible for operating that network reliably and at scale. Our team owns the full life cycle of all space, power, and network assets in all of Google’s data centers and metro points of presence globally. From the foundation, we are involved from site acquisition to construction and are accountable for what space and power is delivered. We're involved in every facet of network delivery from architecture and design to installation, configuration, activation, and commissioning.

description:
**About AlphaSense**
 The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision\-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.
   

  

 The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI\-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S\&P 500\. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 We’re looking for a hands\-on Network Engineer to design, deploy, and enable our global corporate network across offices in APAC. You’ll be the technical expert for physical and virtual networking architecture, driving automation, and ensuring our infrastructure is resilient, scalable, and vendor\-agnostic. This role will partner closely with Corporate Technology, Network Security, and Security Engineering and requires the ability to travel within APAC to support our regional offices.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Architect and implement LAN/WAN/SD\-WAN and Wi\-Fi for multiple global offices.
* Manage Cisco Meraki switches/routers and APs, while staying vendor\-agnostic for future integrations.
* Implement and manage Wi\-Fi EAP (Enterprise Authentication), certificate\-based authentication, and enforce zero\-trust access controls.
* Plan and optimize enterprise Wi\-Fi, including RF design, surveys, and performance tuning.
* Build secure cloud and hybrid networking (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Automate deployments and configuration management with Python, Ansible, and IaC tools (Terraform, GitOps).
* Implement observability and alerting; drive improvements in MTTR and service reliability.
* Support compliance (SOC 2, ISO 27001\) with configs, change control, and documentation.
* Travel regionally (approx. 25–40% during buildouts) for on\-site deployments and architecture reviews.


 Who You Are
   

  

* 8–10\+ years in enterprise networking, with multi\-site design and operations experience.
* Deep expertise in routing, switching, and segmentation.Proven experience with Cisco networking technology, especially Cisco Meraki.
* Proficient in Python and Ansible for automation.
* Skilled in NAC/RADIUS integrations with identity providers (Okta, Azure AD).
* Strong understanding of certificate\-based authentication, EAP, and zero\-trust architectures.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and leadership skills.
* Willing and able to travel internationally for deployments.


**Nice To Have**
* Cloud networking depth (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Experience with SASE/ZTNA platforms(Cloudflare/Zscaler).
* Professional certifications (CCNP, CCIE, JNCIP, etc.)


 AlphaSense is an equal\-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non\-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.
   

  

 In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.
   

  

 Recruiting Scams and Fraud
   

  

 We At AlphaSense Have Been Made Aware Of Fraudulent Job Postings And Individuals Impersonating AlphaSense Recruiters. These Scams May Involve Fake Job Offers, Requests For Sensitive Personal Information, Or Demands For Payment. Please Note
   

  

* AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
* All official communications will come from an @alpha\-sense.com email address.
* If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.


 If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

Sphera is a leading global provider of enterprise software and services that enables companies to manage and optimize their environmental, health, safety and sustainability. Our mission is to create a safer, more sustainable and productive world.
   

  

 Sphera is a portfolio company of Blackstone, a U.S.\-based alternative asset investment company that focuses on private equity, technology and innovation, and more. Blackstone businesses succeed through strong partnerships, a personalized approach and a commitment to exceptional performance with uncompromising integrity. Sphera and Blackstone are leaders in the Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) space.
   

  

 We are guided by our core values of Customer Centricity, Accountability, Bias to Action, Innovation, and Collaboration. These values help us recruit the right talent to join our rapidly expanding team of around the globe. It is important to us that each and every Spherion is not only eager to challenge themselves and knows how to get work done but is an awesome addition to our company culture.
   

  

 SENIOR TECHNICAL WRITER \- TECHNICAL WRITING
   

  

**Summary:** 
 This career path is responsible for creating, developing, planning, writing and editing operational, instructional, maintenance or test procedures for multimedia or web\-based publications, from planning stage through delivery.
   

  

 This position requires delivery responsibilities for multiple related solution family projects.
   

  

**General Job Duties**
* Coordinate writing projects across teams that require multiple outputs
* Performs analysis to determine user assistance requirements
* Designs, creates, updates, and maintains some or all of the following user assistance deliverables: online Help, training materials, user’s guides; release notes; installation, configuration, troubleshooting, and quick reference guides, demonstration videos
* Strong understanding of technical writing processes to produce a consistent level of accuracy and timeliness of work
* Responsible for meeting one or more team quality metrics and for reviewing the quality of work of independently or as part of a team
* Requires consistent use of independent judgment to proactively problem\-solve issues
* Regularly reviews documentation for grammar, consistency, technical accuracy, and good organization
* Performs other duties as required


**Requirements**
* Possess a relevant Bachelors Technical Communications, English, Journalism or related field or equivalent experience and / or professional certification
* 5\+ years of experience in profession


**Other Skills**
* Strong analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Knowledge of databases, client\-server and cloud\-based applications.
* Strong interpersonal skills – must be able to work effectively as part of a project/program team and foster team cooperation.
* Demonstrated project management experience
* Must have understanding of Technical Documentation processes and procedures.
* Must have extensive experience interviewing Subject Matter Experts and converting that information into clear and concise user documentation.
* Must be able to learn new software and technologies quickly.
* Must have experience in a software development environment.
* Experience with RoboHelp, Framemaker, Word, PowerPoint, and Visio beneficial.
* Knowledge of HTML/XML/DITA/Structured Authoring is an asset.
* Ability to comprehend current developments in their area of expertise
* Very strong oral and written communication skills
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment with teams that are not co\-located
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously.
* Self\-starter, proactive, and team player.


**Physical Requirements**
* Ability to physically perform general office requirements.
* Must be able to perform essential responsibilities with or without reasonable accommodations.


**Travel**
* Occasional travel including overnight domestic or international trips may be required.


 Sphera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all colleagues.
   

  

 This job description is intended to convey information essential to understanding the scope of the job and the general nature and level of work performed by job holders within this job. This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of qualifications, skills, efforts, duties, responsibilities or working conditions associated with the position.

title: Senior Technical Writer
description:
Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions.
   

  

 Senior Technical Writer
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bengaluru \& Chennai, India
   

  

**Department:** 
 Technical Communication Center of Excellence
   

  

**Company:** 
 Xylem Water Solutions India Private Limited, Global Capability Center, Bangalore
   

  

**About Xylem**
 Xylem is a leading global water technology company committed to solving the world’s most challenging water issues through innovation. Our mission is to enable sustainable, efficient water use and management for communities, industries, and the environment.
   

  

**About The Position**
 As a Senior Technical Writer at Xylem, you will be part of the Global Technical Communication Center of Excellence, responsible for developing world\-class customer documentation (Hardware/Software). You will author and manage content within a Component Content Management System (CCMS), collaborating closely with Project Coordinators and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) globally. Your work will support customers of Xylem products and systems through clear, accurate, and user\-focused documentation such as Installation and Operation Instructions, Service Manuals, and other technical publications.
   

  

 As you grow in this role, you will have opportunities to contribute to continuous improvement projects, process optimization, and training initiatives within Xylem’s documentation ecosystem.
   

  

**About The Technical Communication Center Of Excellence**
 A global team of technical information specialists responsible for developing customer product information across Xylem’s product portfolio. The team focuses on intelligent content reuse using XML\-based technologies, ensuring all publications are customer\-centric, reusable, and globally consistent across multiple outputs, channels, and languages.
   

  

 Prominent collaterals include Installation and Operation Instructions, Datasheets, Quick Guides, UI Guides, and UX Guides, Technical specifications etc.
   

  

 The team consists of a Content Development (Production) Team, a Localization Team, and a Documentation Systems Team.
   

  

**About The Team In Bengaluru \& Chennai (GCC)**
 The Global Capability Center (GCC) in Bengaluru \& Chennai serves as a shared service; resources supporting Xylem’s global product portfolio — including pumps, turbines, monitoring and control systems, and water analysis equipment. The team contributes to product design, development, testing, and technical documentation to deliver innovative and reliable water technology solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Content Development
   

  

* Develop reusable, structured technical content aligned with Xylem’s authoring guidelines, information model, and style guide.
* Conduct task analysis (TA) and prepare annotated topic lists (ATL).
* Create and maintain Topics, Chaptermaps, Bookmaps, and metadata within the CCMS.
* Produce and maintain illustrations, graphics, and photo\-realistic renderings.
* Ensure the completion of review cycle and software\-assisted checks for grammar, style, and terminology.
* Initiate translation requests and coordinate translation reviews.
* Communicate release updates to stakeholders via designated channels.
* Contribute to the development of the CCMS structure, templates, and information model.
* Participate in initiatives to enhance documentation quality, workflow efficiency, and content governance.


**Required Qualifications**
 Education
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electronics, Aeronautical, Computer Science, or equivalent field).


**Experience**
* 4–6 years of professional experience as a Technical Writer (Senior level) in an international, English\-language environment.
* Proven expertise in DITA XML authoring and single\-sourcing practices.
* Basic experience creating technical illustrations in vector or raster formats.


 Skills and Competencies
   

  

 Core Skills
   

  

* Excellent command of written and spoken English.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and documentation skills.
* Detail\-oriented, structured, and dependable on meeting deadlines.
* Effective communicator with global, cross\-functional teams.
* Familiarity with Simplified Technical English (STE) and style guides such as the Microsoft or Chicago Manual of Style.
* Understanding of DDLC, SDLC, and Agile workflows.
* Knowledge of single sourcing, metadata management, and conditional profiling.


 Technical Skills
   

  

* Proficiency in DITA XML and CCMS platforms such as Astoria On\-Demand or AEM.
* Skilled in XML editors such as Oxygen XML Editor or Arbortext Editor.
* Experience with terminology and content quality tools such as Acrolinx.
* Proficiency with illustration tools (Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Creo Illustrate, Keyshot).
* Experience with collaboration tools like JIRA and Confluence.
* Understanding of content publishing pipelines and localization workflows.
* Working knowledge of XML\-based formats and related technologies (XQuery, metadata tagging).
* Interest in GenAI and automation using Python or similar programming languages is desirable.


 Assessment Process
   

  

* Candidates will complete a writing and structuring test to demonstrate technical English and content organization skills.
* Successful candidates will advance to subsequent interview rounds with technical and hiring teams


 Join the global Xylem team to be a part of innovative technology solutions transforming water usage, conservation, and re\-use. Our products impact public utilities, industrial sectors, residential areas, and commercial buildings, with a commitment to providing smart metering, network technologies, and advanced analytics for water, electric, and gas utilities. Partner with us in creating a world where water challenges are met with ingenuity and dedication; where we recognize the power of inclusion and belonging in driving innovation and allowing us to compete more effectively around the world.

**Job Title –** 
**BUSINESS ANALYST**
**Introduction**
 DHL is a leading global brand in the logistics industry. DHL’s family of divisions offers an unrivalled portfolio of logistics services, ranging from national and international parcel delivery, international express, road, air and ocean transport, to industrial supply chain management. With its unrivalled presence in developing markets, DHL is decisively positioned as “THE logistics company for the world”.
   

  

 DHL Express is a company that pioneered cross\-border express delivery in 1969 \& now is active in more than 220 countries and territories worldwide. We connect people and improve their lives. And we do it by being uncompromisingly customer\-centric and delivering excellence day in and day out. By bringing people together and making life simpler – for our customers, our employees, our investors, and our society – we help make the world a better place.

title: ERP Business Analyst - Tax Management
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

 The ERP Tax Management team acts as a technical partner, managing digital solutions for indirect tax, direct tax, and transfer pricing. This multi\-cultural, dynamic group leverages a mix of complementary skills to navigate and implement new tax mandates across the globe. Their primary mission is to design standardized global templates that provide a consistent digital framework for the entire organization. Simultaneously, they must remain agile enough to adapt these templates to meet unique local requirements for different affiliates. By bridging the gap between tax law and IT systems, they ensure seamless compliance across all international entities. They are responsible for the end\-to\-end delivery of technical mandates that protect the company's global financial position.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 In this role, you will be a key driver in our digital tax transformation, ensuring our global operations remain compliant and efficient. Your mission is to bridge the gap between complex tax laws and innovative IT systems within a dynamic team environment.
   

  

* Design Automated Logic: You will analyze intricate business requirements to design and deliver advanced automated tax determination logic within SAP S/4HANA using condition techniques.
* Drive Cross\-Module Integration: You will ensure seamless integration of tax requirements across SD, MM, and FI modules to maintain consistent tax treatment throughout the entire supply chain.
* Lead Digital Reporting: You will support the technical setup for local statutory requirements, focusing on high\-impact areas like real\-time reporting and e\-invoicing (e.g., SDI, CFDI).
* Manage Tax Engines: You will configure and maintain critical interfaces between SAP and external tax engines such as ONESOURCE or Sovos for real\-time, accurate rate calculations.
* Bridge Business and IT: You will act as the primary liaison, translating complex global tax laws into clear, actionable functional specifications for technical teams.
* Ensure System Quality: You will lead comprehensive end\-to\-end testing cycles, including Unit Testing, System Integration Testing (SIT), and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Mitigate Global Risk: You will proactively resolve complex production issues where tax calculations or e\-invoice submissions fail in high\-volume transaction environments.
* Foster Innovation: You will contribute to the evolution of our global standardized templates, balancing consistency with the agility needed for local affiliate requirements.


 Who you are
   

  

 You are a proactive problem\-solver who thrives on the intersection of technology and finance. You bring a meticulous approach to compliance and a passion for optimizing digital frameworks.
   

  

* Experienced Professional: You possess a minimum of 8\+ years of hands\-on implementation experience, including at least two full project lifecycles as an SAP SD/MM functional consultant.
* Academic Foundation: You hold a Bachelor or Master degree in Computer Science, Business Administration, or an equivalent field of study.
* Tax Subject Matter Expert: You have expert knowledge of SAP Indirect Tax (VAT/GST) setup, with deep experience in complex EU tax rules within large MNC environments.
* Technical Troubleshooter: You possess strong ABAP debugging skills, allowing you to effectively troubleshoot complex tax calculation and interface issues.
* Regulatory Tech Specialist: You have experience implementing e\-invoice submission frameworks; familiarity with SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC) is a significant plus.
* Collaborative Communicator: You demonstrate excellent communication and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders across a multi\-cultural environment.
* Language Proficient: You are fluent in English (written and verbal), which is essential for our global collaboration and documentation. \#RDT2026


 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
   

  

 Let’s build a healthier future, together.

title: Software Developer
description:
**Job Description**
**In this Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**
* In this role, you’ll help Translate Emerson’s digital transformation goals into executable, scalable agent development activities.
* Work for AI\-enabled applications and agent\-based solutions.
* Implement AI agents within the Ovation Intelligence ecosystem.
* Work with team of AI engineers, software developers, and domain SMEs in developing AI agents.
* Actively participate in the design and implementation of the Agent Builder platform used to create custom user agents for diagnostics, automation, engineering workflows, and operational support.
* Ensure the quality of the agents to meaningfully improve operator awareness, reduce troubleshooting time, enhance engineering productivity, and enable predictive maintenance workflows.
* Work closely with Engineering, Architecture, UX, QA, and domain SMEs to define agent use cases and deployment strategies.
* Work with Cybersecurity teams to enforce Emerson’s rigorous security standards for AI\-driven solutions.
* Work with infrastructure and platform teams to align compute, GPU usage, and performance requirements.


**Who You Are:**
 You have a strong bottom\-line orientation. You learn quickly when facing new situations. You ask the right questions to accurately analyze situations. You introduce new ways of looking at problems. You orchestrate multiple activities simultaneously to accomplish a goal.
   

  

**For This Role, You Will Need:**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, AI/ML, or related fields.
* 1–5 years of hands\-on experience in AI/ML model development, deployment, and optimization, with a track record of driving innovation and efficiency in real\-world applications.
* Experience with large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), agent architectures, and industrial AI applications.
* Understanding of distributed systems, cloud/on\-prem architectures, APIs, and enterprise software development practices.
* Understanding of software development processes, including definition of requirements, testing and validation, and deployment.


**Preferred Qualifications that Set You Apart:**
* We’re looking for someone with strong expertise in machine learning, deep learning, and generative AI, including LLMs, Agentic AI and its applications. Proficiency in C\#, Python, TensorFlow/PyTorch is essential, along with hands\-on experience deploying AI in real\-world, industrial environments.
* Prior experience with Emerson Ovation, industrial control systems (DCS/SCADA), or power plant operations.
* Knowledge of operational technology (OT) networks, cybersecurity principles, and safety\-critical system constraints.
* Experience deploying AI solutions in regulated or mission\-critical environments.
* Familiarity with ML Ops, prompt engineering, and AI reliability frameworks.


**Our Culture \& Commitment to You**
 At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams, working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.
   

  

 We recognize the importance of employee wellbeing. We prioritize providing competitive benefits plans, a variety of medical insurance plans, Employee Assistance Program, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture offers flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.
   

  

**About Us**
**WHY EMERSON**
**Our Commitment to Our People**
 At Emerson, we are motivated by a spirit of collaboration that helps our diverse, multicultural teams across the world drive innovation that makes the world healthier, safer, smarter, and more sustainable. And we want you to join us in our bold aspiration.
   

  

 We have built an engaged community of inquisitive, dedicated people who thrive knowing they are welcomed, trusted, celebrated, and empowered to solve the world’s most complex problems — for our customers, our communities, and the planet. You’ll contribute to this vital work while further developing your skills through our award\-winning employee development programs. We are a proud corporate citizen in every city where we operate and are committed to our people, our communities, and the world at large. We take this responsibility seriously and strive to make a positive impact through every endeavor.
   

  

 At Emerson, you’ll see firsthand that our people are at the center of everything we do. So, let’s go. Let’s think differently. Learn, collaborate, and grow. Seek opportunity. Push boundaries. Be empowered to make things better. Speed up to break through. Let’s go, together.
   

  

**Accessibility Assistance or Accommodation**
 If you have a disability and are having difficulty accessing or using this website to apply for a position, please contact: idisability.administrator@emerson.com .
   

  

**About Emerson**
 Emerson is a global leader in automation technology and software. Through our deep domain expertise and legacy of flawless execution, Emerson helps customers in critical industries like life sciences, energy, power and renewables, chemical and advanced factory automation operate more sustainably while improving productivity, energy security and reliability.
   

  

 With global operations and a comprehensive portfolio of software and technology, we are helping companies implement digital transformation to measurably improve their operations, conserve valuable resources and enhance their safety.
   

  

 We offer equitable opportunities, celebrate diversity, and embrace challenges with confidence that, together, we can make an impact across a broad spectrum of countries and industries. Whether you’re an established professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring possibilities, or a recent graduate with an advanced degree, you’ll find your chance to make a difference with Emerson. Join our team – let’s go!
   

  

**No calls or agencies please.**

description:
**About Us**
 Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
   

  

 At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
   

  

 Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are seeking a highly motivated Software Engineer to join our VERA Backend API Services team.
   

  

 You will help build the foundational backend systems and APIs that power Visa’s global payment network. This role is ideal for early‑career engineers who love coding, enjoy solving technical problems, and want to build expertise in secure, scalable distributed systems.
   

  

 You will work closely with senior engineers, contributing to the development of backend services used across a global ecosystem while strengthening your engineering craft in a high‑performance environment.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Develop and enhance backend API services following well‑defined designs and secure coding standards.
* Write clean, maintainable code and develop unit tests with strong code coverage.
* Participate in code reviews, receive feedback from senior engineers, and continuously improve your technical skills.
* Troubleshoot defects, support QA and operations teams, and help ensure smooth deployments.
* Collaborate with your team to understand requirements, clarify technical details, and deliver high‑quality features.
* Learn backend architecture, automation, telemetry, logging, and reliability practices.
* Contribute to engineering excellence by following consistent coding patterns, security guidelines, and operational best practices.


 This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in the office will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Basic Qualifications: Bachelor's degree, OR 3\+ years of relevant work experience Preferred Qualifications: Bachelor's degree, OR 3\+ years of relevant work experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field — or equivalent practical experience. Internship or prior experience working on backend components or cloud‑based services. Exposure to cloud technologies (AWS, GCP, or Azure) is a plus. What We’re Looking For Strong programming fundamentals and experience with Java or similar backend languages. Understanding of REST APIs, microservices, and distributed systems basics. Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks. Interest in secure coding, backend architecture, and large‑scale systems. Growth mindset, curiosity, and willingness to learn from senior engineers.

Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.
